news.Title: Microsoft's Biggest AI Customer Is Also Its Biggest Risk
news.Content:
Microsoft's (NASDAQ:MSFT) fiscal 2026 annual report, filed in late July, put a hard number on a relationship investors have largely had to gauge from the outside. The company booked $24.1 billion of revenue from its commercial arrangements with OpenAI, and the ChatGPT maker owed Microsoft $6.0 billion at June 30.

For perspective, Microsoft's total revenue for fiscal 2026 (the 12 months ended June 30) was $331.8 billion, up 18% year over year. OpenAI alone contributed about 7% of it. No other customer is identified, or given a number, in the filing.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 15x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

In my view, that one line conveys both sides of the Microsoft story. The company owns a big chunk of OpenAI, so it benefits if the ChatGPT maker keeps scaling. But it's also spending huge amounts building infrastructure for a customer that reportedly spends much more cash than it brings in.

Image source: Getty Images.

A $24.1 billion customer

The disclosure is there because Microsoft is a part owner of OpenAI -- a big enough owner that accounting rules classify the artificial intelligence (AI) leader as a related party and require Microsoft to report the money moving between them.

The filing notes the $24.1 billion includes revenue-sharing payments, but it doesn't break the total down. Investors can't tell how much came from OpenAI renting Azure computing power and how much came from OpenAI paying Microsoft a cut of its own sales.

Whatever the split, the size is striking. Azure, Microsoft's cloud computing platform, topped $100 billion of revenue for the first time in fiscal 2026, growing 41% year over year. OpenAI's arrangements alone equaled about a quarter of that.

Microsoft doesn't rank its customers, and it says that none made up more than 10% of revenue. But OpenAI is the only one it names, and it is difficult to picture another AI customer anywhere close to this size.

The backlog leans on OpenAI even harder

The greater concentration lies in the revenue Microsoft has already signed up for the future. The company finished fiscal 2026 with $678 billion of commercial remaining performance obligations (contracted work it has not yet delivered or invoiced), up 84% year over year. Excluding OpenAI, chief financial officer Amy Hood said on the July earnings call, that backlog grew 25%. Put another way, most of the year's growth in contracted future revenue comes from one customer.

Story Continues

That's mainly because OpenAI committed last October, as part of its corporate restructuring, to buy an additional $250 billion of Azure services.

Of course, there's a flip side. Microsoft came out of that restructuring with around 27% of OpenAI at the time, a stake it valued at about $135 billion. If OpenAI keeps scaling, Microsoft collects twice -- once by providing its computing power, and again as a part owner.

What if the spending slows down?

The risk is that OpenAI isn't a typical anchor customer. The company burned $3.7 billion in the first three months of 2026, according to The Information . More recently, the Financial Times said that OpenAI expects to burn through almost $280 billion of cash from 2026 through 2030. After all, a business using up cash at that rate can keep spending only as long as investors keep financing it.

The terms of the relationship have loosened, too. In April, the companies revised their deal. OpenAI's revenue-sharing payments to Microsoft now extend through 2030 with a total cap. And OpenAI can now serve its products to customers via any cloud provider, although Microsoft is still its main partner and its products ship first on Azure.

Microsoft, meanwhile, has been building as if the demand is permanent. Its additions to property and equipment totaled $115.9 billion in fiscal 2026, up almost 80% from $64.6 billion the year before, which itself was up about 45% from the year before that.

If OpenAI ever slowed its spending, Azure's growth rate could reflect it quickly. So could that backlog.

Granted, the other 93% of Microsoft's revenue comes from a customer base about as broad as any in business, and operating income grew 21% in fiscal 2026. But the growth story behind the stock leans on Azure, and Azure now leans on OpenAI more than on any other single name.

At about $494 as of this writing, shares trade about 11% below their 52-week high and at about 28 times earnings. Plenty of continued cloud growth is already baked into that price, and OpenAI is a significant part of what is driving the growth.

In the end, I believe the disclosure is a reason for attention, not alarm. The business is excellent. But more of its growth than ever seems to rely on one customer's spending. That's why I see Microsoft stock as a hold right now.

news.Title: Stock market today: Nasdaq, Dow and S&P 500 little changed as AI trade powers market
news.Content:
US stock futures steadied on Tuesday after confidence in artificial intelligence and falling oil prices spurred a rally on Wall Street.

Futures on the Nasdaq-100 ( NQ=F ) fell below the flatline after the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite touched a record high the day before. S&P 500 futures ( ES=F ) were little changed, while those on the Dow Jones Industrial Average ( YM=F ) slipped 0.2%.

Stocks kicked off the week with strong gains as US and Chinese officials wrapped up talks ahead of a capstone meeting between President Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent called the preliminary talks "very successful," lifting hopes of cooperation on artificial intelligence.

Meta ( META ) shares, which popped 11% on Monday, lifted the "Magnificent Seven" stocks after the company's Muse AI agent app hit the top spot in the App Store, sending a bullish signal about chip demand.

The US rally in tech stocks spilled over into Asian markets, with the Nikkei ( ^N225 ) and KOSPI ( ^KS11 ) indexes gaining on Tuesday. Although oil prices ticked up again, improved oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz have kept the critical product below $100 per barrel.

KB Home ( KBH ) and AutoZone ( AZO ) report earnings on Tuesday amid a light week for economic data and earnings.

"The drop in oil ⁠is a big factor," said Nick Twidale, chief market strategist at ATFX Global. "Oil is the main driver and investors are jumping back into AI as has been the pattern this year."

news.Title: Warren Buffett Just Stepped Down. These 2 AI Stocks Still Define Berkshire’s Portfolio
news.Content:
Warren Buffett formally stepped down as Berkshire Hathaway's chairman on September 18, ending more than five decades in the job and handing the nonexecutive chairmanship to his son Howard Buffett. Greg Abel already runs Berkshire as CEO, while Buffett remains a director and chairman emeritus.

The succession makes Berkshire's equity portfolio more interesting than usual. Two of its largest technology holdings are Apple Inc. (NASDAQ: AAPL ) and Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ: GOOGL ), giving the company exposure to two very different versions of the AI trade.

Krista Kennell/Shutterstock.com

Berkshire owns distribution rather than the hottest AI hardware

Apple remains one of Berkshire's largest publicly traded positions. Its AI case is not based on selling GPUs. Apple owns a giant installed base of premium devices, which gives it an unusually direct route for distributing AI services if those products become useful enough to change consumer behavior.

That advantage comes with an obvious problem. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has spent much of the generative-AI boom looking slower than Google, OpenAI and Meta. The bull case is that Apple can monetize AI once the technology becomes reliable enough for mass-market deployment. The bear case is that controlling distribution matters less if consumers increasingly choose software ecosystems independently of their devices.

Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) offers almost the inverse exposure. Berkshire dramatically expanded its Alphabet position in Q2, with the holding reaching nearly 106 million shares worth roughly $37.8 billion at quarter end. Google already operates frontier models, AI infrastructure, cloud services and consumer products at global scale. AI can strengthen Search, Cloud and YouTube, but it can also change the economics of the search advertising franchise that funds much of Alphabet's spending.

The holdings predate Buffett's chairmanship transition

Across Insider Monkey's tracked funds, Apple ownership slipped to 169 hedge funds in Q2 from 170 in Q1. Arrowstreet Capital held about 29.9 million shares after increasing its position 54%. Alphabet moved in the opposite direction: 275 funds held GOOGL, up from 265, while Arrowstreet held nearly 15 million shares after trimming its position 13%.

Apple had roughly 139.7 million shares sold short at the August 31 settlement date, about 1% of public float, with roughly 3.5 days to cover.

None of this means Buffett personally chose the two stocks as an AI portfolio. Berkshire's investment organization is broader than Buffett, and Abel now controls capital allocation. What the portfolio does show is more interesting: Berkshire enters a new leadership era owning two of the strongest distribution systems through which consumer AI could eventually be monetized.

Story Continues

While we acknowledge the potential of AAPL and GOOGL as investments, we believe certain other AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. news.Title: KOSPI週二震盪小漲0.15%連三紅，樂金電子飆6.91%成大型股領頭羊
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】韓股連續兩天急漲4.35%後，週二迎來美股那指追高2.26%並改寫新高的利多，首爾綜合股價指數(KOSPI)開盤不到15分鐘一度急漲2.30%，觸及7,171.44點日高；但短線累計漲幅可觀，引發獲利了結賣壓，製藥及鋼鐵類股領跌，指數盤中一度失守7,000點、下探6,986.27點，終場僅漲10.19點或0.15%，收在7,017.91點，連三紅並創9月16日以來最高收盤水準。十九大類股漲多跌少，營建及運輸儲存類股各大漲2.51%和2.18%，為盤面兩大領漲族群；主流電子類股僅小漲0.11%，大致與大盤同步。早盤受美國科技股強彈激勵的半導體類股隨後分化，三星電子(005930)終場漲0.91%，收報27.65萬韓元；SK海力士(000660)則由紅翻黑，收跌1.50%至184萬韓元，成為壓抑指數漲幅的主要權值股之一。

LG集團控股公司LG Corp.(003550)週二宣布，與微軟(Microsoft，美股代碼MSFT)擴大戰略合作，範圍涵蓋AI數據中心基礎設施、企業AI轉型及實體AI，帶動LG集團相關股票逆勢走強。LG Corp.早盤漲幅一度擴大，終場大漲5,200韓元或4.67%，收在11.65萬韓元，盤中最高觸及11.92萬韓元。

樂金電子(066570)表現更為強勁，終場大漲1.4萬韓元或6.91%，收報21.65萬韓元，盤中最高來到22.1萬韓元，成為韓國三十檔大型股(KTOP30)領頭羊。市場將這項合作視為樂金集團由傳統消費電子進一步切入AI數據中心、企業AI與實體AI應用的重要訊號，使其股價在大盤漲幅大幅收斂之際仍維持強勢。

news.Title: 【盤後焦點】台股創高壓回震盪801點　上漲81點創收盤新高
news.Content:
（中央社記者潘智義台北2026年09月22日電）美股齊揚，那斯達克指數創高，費城半導體指數及台積電ADR走揚，激勵台股早盤衝上48601.53點的歷史新高點；隨後長假前調節賣壓加重、台積電中場翻黑，台股高低震盪801.36點，終場上漲81.33點，以47800.17點創下台股收盤新高。

加權指數終場收在47800.17點，漲81.33點，漲幅0.17%，成交金額新台幣1兆215.69億元。

台積電 (2330) 盤中由紅翻黑，收2460元，跌20元，跌幅0.81%；聯發科 (2454) 早盤衝上5480元歷史高點後漲勢收斂，收在5180元，漲170元，漲幅3.39%；台達電 (2308) 收1900元，漲25元，漲幅1.33%；鴻海 (2317) 收253元，上揚3元，漲幅1.2%。

高價股方面，股王信驊 (5274) 早盤攻上漲停21800元，收在20905元，漲幅5.47%，同創個股盤中及收盤新高紀錄；股后川湖 (2059) 開高走低收在12670元，下挫130元，跌幅1.02%；千金股創意 (3443) 鎖住漲停價8375元收盤，再創新高，力旺 (3529) 也收在漲停板3110元。另外，嘉澤 (3533) 、高力 (8996) 、南電 (8046) 、欣興 (3037) 等千金股衝高漲停，千金股合計49檔。

傳聞英特爾有意與友達 (2409) 合作先進封裝技術，友達連兩天鎖注漲停價，收36.65元。沙烏地阿拉伯石油擴大出口，國際油價下挫，台塑四寶台塑 (1301) 、南亞 (1303) 、台化 (1326) 、台塑化 (6505) 齊跌。

兆豐國際投顧副總經理黃國偉接受電訪表示，台股創高後震盪，成交量未有效放大，面對即將到來的中秋節連假，不排除有投資人獲利了結。雖然日前又爆發美伊衝突，但目前並無擴大跡象；川習會前也未見劍拔弩張氣氛，短線應無大利空或大利多情況下，台股創高後，恐以盤堅機率較大。（編輯：張良知）

news.Title: 信驊衝破2萬元！股王飆21800元創台股天價
news.Content:
【王宇德／台北報導】台股股王信驊（5274）今（22）日股價再創歷史新高，開盤直接跳空漲停，衝上21800元，正式突破2萬元大關，單日大漲1980元，不僅刷新信驊自身股價紀錄，也創下台股個股股價及單日上漲金額新高，成為市場矚目的「2萬元股王」。

信驊主要產品為伺服器管理晶片（BMC），受惠人工智慧（AI）基礎建設需求強勁，今年營運高速成長。公司累計前8月營收達101.68億元，年增74.49%，首度突破百億元大關，並預期第3、4季營收可望延續逐季創高走勢。

展望明年，信驊目前掌握的訂單總量已超越今年全年營收，出貨量可望大幅成長。為確保產能供應穩定，公司日前也與日月光半導體簽訂2年採購合約，提前布局AI伺服器需求，更隨AI伺服器需求持續升溫，信驊股價今日正式站上2萬元，再度寫下台股高價股新紀錄。

news.Title: Not Micron. Not Alphabet. Here's My Top Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock Pick for the Next 3 Years.
news.Content:
There are some incredible artificial intelligence (AI) stocks to invest in right now. Micron (NASDAQ: MU) is booming from a memory chip shortage and looks primed to continue rising. Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOG) (NASDAQ: GOOGL) is experiencing success on several fronts in the AI arms race, and looks poised to deliver strong returns as well. However, neither of these stocks has anything on Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA).

Nvidia is at the heart of the AI build-out, and looks like a stock primed to continue rising over the next few years. I think that makes it a top stock to buy in today's market, and investors should consider loading up on shares now to benefit from its absurdly low valuation.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Nvidia expects huge growth in the future

For as long as the AI arms race has been going on, the question surrounding Nvidia has been: Can it keep up its growth rate? While the resounding answer from most investors has been "No," Nvidia continues to defy expectations and even provides guidance to back it up.

For next year, Nvidia expects to grow its revenue at a 70% pace. Given how large a company Nvidia is, that's an incredible projection. There has never been a company as large as Nvidia, let alone half the size, that has grown this rapidly. The market really doesn't know what to do with the stock, as all of the numbers indicate that Nvidia will be a far larger company than any other U.S. business. However, I know what to do: Buy the stock.

Nvidia is at the heart of the AI arms race and will remain there due to its early lead. Nvidia's GPUs are best in the business, and with a new architecture launching, they will unlock features and capabilities previously unthinkable. While there is some rising competition for custom AI chips, there will always be a place for Nvidia GPUs due to their flexibility and universal nature. This positions Nvidia well to thrive in the coming years and could allow the stock to reach new heights.

But just how far can it go?

Nvidia's valuation is cheap for its potential

Right now, Nvidia's stock trades at a very attractive 28 times earnings.

NVDA PE Ratio data by YCharts

That's a pretty typical valuation for a big tech stock, but there's only one problem: Nvidia is no ordinary big tech stock. No other big tech stock is growing as quickly as Nvidia. Its peers, Advanced Micro Devices and Broadcom , trade at 144x and 46x earnings, respectively.

Story Continues

That's a major mismatch, and there's really no reason for Nvidia to trade as cheaply as it is, especially considering its guidance for the next fiscal year.

With Nvidia trading at a non-inflated price now, the 70% growth it projects next year could easily translate into stock performance gains. It's rare that the market hands you an investment that can rise 70% in a year with little chance of failing, but that's what the market is giving you in Nvidia. While there aren't any projections beyond next year, Nvidia has told investors it expects global data center capital expenditures to rise to between $3 trillion and $4 trillion by 2030. That means there's even more upside ahead for Nvidia, and with it having a pretty low starting point, that makes Nvidia the top AI stock pick right now.

Even if you already have a healthy portion of your portfolio allocated to Nvidia stock, this is an incredible setup, and I think any investor should consider buying it right now.

news.Title: Is Generac Holdings Inc. (GNRC) Stock a Top AI Infrastructure Play After $2.4 Billion Amazon Deal?
news.Content:
Generac Holdings Inc. (NYSE: GNRC ) is gaining momentum in its efforts to evolve from a traditional generator manufacturer into a major power infrastructure supplier for the rapidly expanding data center industry. On September 16, the company announced a long-term supply agreement to provide backup generators for Amazon data centers.

The agreement represents a potentially significant catalyst for Generac, with deliveries expected to be worth approximately $2.4 billion in 2027 and 2028. Generac also issued a warrant to Amazon NV Investment Holdings to purchase up to 1.69 million shares of Generac common stock at an exercise price of $200.93 per share.

Kritchanut/Shutterstock.com

Following the announcement, shares of Generac moved higher as investors assessed the potential impact of the agreement on the company's data center growth prospects.

In a September 16 research note, Cantor Fitzgerald reiterated its Overweight rating on Generac and maintained a $333 price target. The firm described the long-term supply agreement as an important data center disclosure that is central to the investment thesis surrounding the company.

Amazon Deal Expands Generac's Data Center Exposure

The rapid expansion of Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN)'s cloud computing and artificial intelligence infrastructure is creating additional demand for reliable backup power systems. Generac is positioned to benefit from this trend as data centers require resilient power infrastructure to maintain operations during grid disruptions.

The opportunity builds on an already substantial data center business. When Generac Holdings Inc. (NYSE:GNRC) reported second quarter results, it noted that its backlog had reached a $1.6 billion backlog, excluding committed volumes from its second hyperscale customer, for products serving the data center market. The Amazon agreement therefore provides an additional avenue for the company to capitalize on growing hyperscale data center investment.

The agreement could also improve Generac's revenue visibility over the next several years while increasing its exposure to hyperscale customers and AI-related infrastructure spending. Generac has been investing in additional manufacturing capacity to address this demand, including plans to invest roughly $250 million through the end of 2027 to expand production capacity.

Risks to Consider

Despite the potential benefits, investors should distinguish between the agreement's initial commitment and its longer-term potential. While the current deal includes approximately $2.4 billion of expected deliveries in 2027 and 2028, The warrant structure provides for additional shares to vest as cumulative gross payments from Amazon and its affiliates for backup generators increase, with the vesting schedule extending up to $8 billion of aggregate payments. The full $8 billion should not be viewed as contracted revenue.

Story Continues

Generac Holdings Inc. (NYSE:GNRC) must also expand its production capacity for large-megawatt generators while maintaining delivery schedules and product performance. Manufacturing bottlenecks, supply-chain constraints or delays in expanding capacity could prevent the company from converting strong demand into revenue and earnings as quickly as anticipated.

The Amazon relationship also introduces an element of customer concentration risk. A substantial portion of expected future sales could become linked to one hyperscale customer, leaving Generac exposed to changes in Amazon's data center construction plans, capital spending priorities or infrastructure requirements.

Hedge Fund Positioning

Institutional interest in Generac Holdings Inc. (NYSE:GNRC) has increased. According to Insider Monkey's database, 74 hedge funds held positions in the company at the end of the second quarter, up from 66 in the first quarter.

However, some major hedge funds reduced their exposure during the period. Ariel Investments trimmed its position by 23% to approximately $292.21 million, while DE Shaw reduced its stake by 27% to about $280.25 million.

news.Title: Tower Semiconductor (TSEM): $1.3 Billion in Silicon Photonics Contracts Puts AI Growth in Focus
news.Content:
Tower Semiconductor Ltd. (NASDAQ: TSEM ) is positioned to benefit from the rapid growth of optical connectivity as artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure drives demand for faster and more efficient data transmission.

In a September 18 research note, Barclays initiated an Overweight rating on the stock with a $310 price target, citing the company's position in the silicon photonics foundry market.

The growth of AI workloads is creating significant demand for high-speed connectivity. As data centers process increasingly complex AI workloads, operators are upgrading their networks to support higher bandwidth and lower-latency communication. This is driving demand for advanced optical interconnects, creating an attractive growth opportunity for semiconductor companies exposed to the market.

Photo by Sergei Starostin on Pexels

Tower Semiconductor already has a leading position in the pluggable optical market and is expanding its capabilities in Silicon Photonics (SiPho), Silicon Germanium (SiGe), and advanced packaging. Its silicon photonics technology is increasingly being incorporated into optical transceivers used to move data across AI data centers.

Management expects the company's position in the market to strengthen as AI data center deployments accelerate.

The opportunity has already translated into significant customer commitments. In May, Tower Semiconductor announced approximately $1.3 billion in contracted business to supply chips used in optical connectivity applications for AI data centers. The company also secured approximately $290 million in customer advance payments to support production demand for its silicon photonics business.

AI Spending Remains a Key Risk

Despite the strong growth opportunity, Tower Semiconductor Ltd. (NASDAQ:TSEM) remains dependent on continued investment in AI infrastructure. A slowdown in spending by hyperscalers and other data center operators could reduce demand for optical connectivity and delay the ramp-up of silicon photonics-related revenue.

Concerns over the sustainability of AI capital spending also represent a potential risk. The rapid expansion of AI infrastructure has resulted in substantial capital commitments from hyperscalers, and any moderation in those investments could affect suppliers throughout the semiconductor and data center ecosystem.

Customer concentration is another consideration. Although Tower Semiconductor has secured $1.3 billion of contracted silicon photonics revenue, changes in the deployment plans of those major customers could affect the timing and pace of future growth.

Story Continues

Competition is also intensifying. Optical connectivity is evolving beyond traditional pluggable optics toward technologies such as co-packaged and near-package optics. Competing foundries and semiconductor suppliers are investing in these emerging technologies, potentially increasing competitive pressure on Tower Semiconductor as the market develops.

Hedge Fund Positioning

According to Insider Monkey's database, institutional interest in Tower Semiconductor Ltd. (NASDAQ:TSEM) increased during the second quarter. The number of hedge funds holding positions in the company rose to 64 from 54 in the first quarter.

Among individual investors, Senvest Management reduced its Tower Semiconductor position by 20% to approximately $475.17 million, while Polar Capital increased its stake by 598% to approximately $264.59 million.

Short interest, meanwhile, remained relatively modest. The number of Tower Semiconductor shares sold short increased from approximately 2.46 million as of July 31 to 2.52 million as of August 31. Even after the increase, short interest represented only about 2.23% of the company's shares.

The Verdict

Tower Semiconductor Ltd. (NASDAQ:TSEM) is gaining increasing exposure to the AI infrastructure buildout through its silicon photonics and optical connectivity businesses. The company's existing position in pluggable optics, investments in SiPho, SiGe, and advanced packaging, and substantial customer commitments provide a foundation for continued growth if AI data center spending remains strong.

However, the investment case is closely tied to the pace of AI infrastructure expansion. Customer concentration, competition in next-generation optical connectivity, and the possibility of slower hyperscaler capital spending remain important risks for investors to monitor.

While we acknowledge the potential of TSEM as an investment, we believe certain AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. news.Title: 台積電供應鏈迅得將持續南下建立生產基地 將發行5億元無擔保CB籌資
news.Content:
台積電 (2330-TW) 供應鏈的設備廠迅得 (6438-TW)對最新營收推進一如預期，迅得8月營收也將維持在6億元以上高檔區， 8月營收6.11億元，改寫歷年同期新高，累計2026年1-8月營收48.18億元，年增11.5%。同時，迅得擬以5億元面額 無擔保可轉換公司債籌資，並在今(22)日獲金管會申報生效。

迅得的此一市場籌資案由台新證券主辦，可望在10月中旬完成募集。同時，迅得在積極擴大營運規模，迅得除投資南科友上科技1.5億元拿下23%股權之外，公司高層指出，迅得將有其他的投資案在進行中；同時，也最快在今年底、明年初在台灣南部取得土地建新廠，用以因應湧入的設備訂單生產。

迅得2026 年第二季營收 18.24 億元創新高，稅後純益1.66億元，單季獲利也超越首季的 1.45 億元，每股純益2.03元。2026年1-6月營收35.68億元，毛利率26.13%，稅後純益3.11億元，每股純益3.79元。而迅得公布最新營收資訊，迅得在2026 年 8月營收以 6.11 億元改寫歷年同期新高。

迅得營運總部也在遷入的新生廠後產能已進人滿載，將推升 2026 年獲利成長幅度攀高。迅得機械在 2026 年第二季營收 18.24 億元創新高，第四季由於安排出貨的半導體設備出貨逐步步入高峰，預估下半年營運勝過 上半年，全年營收將再較 2025 年的 64.67 億元再增 10-15%，再創新高。

迅得 2026 年上半年營收 35.68 億元，年增 11.99%，2026 下半年預估在出貨產品組合的有利因素加持下超過上半年表現 ，全年營收估成長 10-15%，而在獲利成長幅度可望以優於營收成長幅度倍數成長呈現。

迅得擁有在半導體及 PCB 設備需求雙重成長動能，同時，迅得在 PCB 設備指向高階產品廠商的需求，也與臻鼎 - KY(4958-TW) 及景碩 (3189-TW) 有大單確立，其中臻鼎 - KY 下單 10.2 億元，而景碩也在 7 億元之上。

news.Title: 台股盤中噴新高！台塑化破85元能加碼嗎　股人曝指標：買進台塑四寶需要勇氣
news.Content:
台股近來表現強勢。示意圖，與新聞個案無關。（資料照，中央社）

台股9月以來震盪幅度不小，但近期明顯轉強，今（22）日，受美股科技股大漲帶動台股跳空開高，加權指數開盤上漲262.2點，以47,981.04點開出，隨後漲勢進一步擴大，盤中一度衝上48,601.53點，漲幅超過800點，改寫盤中新高。台積電開盤也上漲25元、報2505元。股人阿勳今則臉書以「台塑化起死回生後！？」為題指出，就股價而言，台塑化（6505）從2025年股價最低一度剩30元，短短一年重新站回85元，翻了快3倍，猶如「起死回生」。

台塑四寶股價表現？

9月中旬這一波，塑化股明顯受到油價、塑化報價及8月營收成長等題材帶動，尤其9月17日台塑四寶同步大漲，其中，台塑化（6505）則是四寶近期波動最明顯的一檔。股價走勢盤點如下：

台塑（1301）： 9月14日收62.9元，15日跌至62元，之後連續反彈，9月17日收64.6元、單日漲3.53%，9月18日65元，9月21日再收65.2元，從9月15日低點到21日收盤已反彈約5.16%。

南亞（1303）： 9月15日曾跌至221.5元，16日反彈至224元，17日再大漲5.36%至236元，18日收238元，21日則來到239.5元。也就是說，從9月15日低點到21日，股價已回升約8.1%。

台化（1326）： 9月14日收67.6元，15日跌至65.8元，16日持平，17日大漲4.26%至68.6元；不過18日、21日又稍微拉回，21日收67.8元。這檔近期走勢比較像是「急漲後整理」。

台塑化（6505）： 9月9日受到8月營收年增50.3%等消息激勵，股價單日大漲9.92%、收87.5元；之後回檔，9月11日跌至83.6元，9月17日又大漲7.08%至86.2元，18日收86.5元，21日則收88.5元。從9月11日低點到21日已反彈約5.9%。

台塑化基本面改善？

股人阿勳分析，台塑化此次並非單純股價上漲，就連基本面也出現明顯改善；就財報來看，8月營收819.06億元，年增50.29%，已是6個月營收增加，獲利方面今年從2025年第二季ROE（股東權益報酬率）-1.89%，到今年第二季已達到14.62%。他指出，背後最大的功臣就是煉油事業，除了原油價格因中東戰事提高外，關鍵是全球成品油供給受到干擾，讓煉油利差大幅改善，「價格好＋產量回來」，自然讓獲利快速復甦。他提醒，然而，關鍵是台塑化的產業競爭力是否也同步回升，因為中國產能讓​亞洲石化產業​供過於求的結構性問題仍然存在。

台塑化為何股價大漲？

​股人阿勳表示，他認為此次台塑化獲利大幅改善，因是煉油景氣加地緣政治紅利，大於公司競爭力出的質變，這也是河流圖顯示台塑化目前仍在「偏低」區間、但高估甚至到167元的原因，他會比較保守看待，因最危險的估值方式，就是拿景氣高峰的獲利去乘上一個正常本益比。他總結，台塑化站上85元還能不能漲，這不是重點，而是當地緣政治降溫後，台塑化一年到底還能賺多少？如此才能判斷85元是便宜，還是市場已經反映得差不多了，「現在買台塑四寶需要很大的勇氣」。​

news.Content:

聯發科和創意續創歷史新高價，矽光子全面下跌

news.Title: 電子權值與高價股輪漲，推升指數創歷史新高
news.Content:
【財訊快報／方亞申】美國費半指數週一大漲，以CPU為主的英特爾、AMD、ARM週一全面上漲超過9%以上，晶片股普遍走高。指標美國10年期公債殖利率跌回具有重要心理意義的5%關口之下、布蘭特原油期貨盤中跌破每桶100美元等激勵，美股四大指數週一全面大漲，那指創收盤歷史新高，刺激台股週二開盤後衝歷史新高48,601點。電子高價股信驊(5274)、創意(3443)、聯發科(2454)及矽智財股主攻，封測、面板、ABF等紛紛上漲，不過隨著台積電(2330)由紅翻黑，指數漲幅收斂，終場上漲81.33點，收在47800.17點，成交量1兆215.69億元。沉寂已久的Meta，於9月初推出Muse，可在後台代替使用者預訂旅行、管理行程及購物。據統計Muse已連續3天位居美國iPhone免費App下載榜首，ChatGPT排名第2，Google Gemini居第8，Claude則降至第22。

Muse快速竄紅，也刺激META股價週一大漲11.3%。隨著AI從問答走向實際操作，推論及基礎設施工作負載將增加，進而推升CPU需求，使得三家CPU公司AMD、ARM、英特爾股價都大漲，ARM上漲17%、英特爾上漲12%。

Meta平台新推出的消費級AI智能體Muse迅速走紅，也令市場重新評估智能體普及帶來的運算需求，帶動CPU概念股全面上揚。META股價大漲11%、AMD上漲9%，收在651美元，總市值首度突破1兆美元。Meta目前是AMD第2大客戶，貢獻約5.5%營收。雙方今年2月宣布擴大合作，Meta計劃部署最多6GW的AMD Instinct GPU，首批支援1GW部署的產品預計2026年下半年出貨，並採用以MI450架構為基礎的客製化晶片。Arm預估2030年市場規模可達1,200億美元；AMD則上看2,200億美元。英特爾執行長陳立武上周也表示，公司目前僅能滿足約50%的客戶需求，CPU供應緊張仍將持續。這次半導體主軸轉向CPU。

此外，谷歌、亞馬遜、輝達等高總市值公司股價也緩步上升。那指這次創收盤歷史高點，一反今年以來的弱勢。短線只要四大指數站穩10日線上就屬強勢。

台股8月份以來除少數電子股向上推升之外，有台塑集團及金融股掩護推升，9月以後又轉換成電子股。這次晶圓代工的台積電、聯電(2303)、世界(5347)表現都不錯。矽智財則由高價股創意創高，聯發科跟進，信驊股價也登上2萬元創高，川湖(2059)、大立光(3008)、漢測(7856)、世芯(3661)、力旺(3529)、台光電(2383)以及ABF的欣興(3037)、南電(8046)、臻鼎(4958)、景碩(3189)，加上散熱的富世達(6805)、健策(3653)表現都不錯。

封測族群強勢，日月光(3711)續勢挑戰前波的歷史高價，矽格(6257)、力成(6239)、欣銓(3264)、華東(8110)、京元電(2449)、南茂(8150)等都屬強勢。矽晶圓及台積電耗材中砂(1560)、昇陽半導體(8028)、精材(3374)強勢。傳統半導體績優股瑞昱(2379)、聯詠(3034)及廠務的聖暉*(5536)、漢唐(2404)表現也不錯。面板股友達(2409)因為富采(3714)買進大漲，群創(3481)跟進。

油價下跌，加上美中官員對本週四將登場的「川習會」釋放樂觀信號，台塑四寶下跌，記憶體也拉回。金融股富邦金(2881)及國泰金(2882)穩健。

news.Title: 上市櫃逾千家下跌！台股創高後爆賣壓 收盤小漲台積電跌20元
news.Content:
台股今（22日）早盤一度大漲將近900點衝上48601.53點，再創歷史新高，午盤過後出現獲利了結賣壓，漲勢也跟著收斂，下市櫃下跌家數超過千檔，終場台股僅小漲81.33點收在47800.17點，無法守住48K大關，成交量1.02億元。

權值股台積電開高走低，早盤一度大漲30元觸及2510元，盤中翻黑下跌，最終下跌20元收在2460元；聯發科漲勢也略為收斂，盤中一度逼近漲停，最終上漲170元收在5180元，漲幅仍逾3%，台達電最高觸及1965元，終場漲25元收在1900元。

ABF載板表現強勢，欣興、景碩及南電狂飆漲停，臻鼎-KY也上漲超過4%，股王信驊一度漲停鎖在21800元，最終收在20905元，成為台股首檔2萬元個股，友達飆上漲停，彩晶大漲超過4%。電子五哥、記憶體與金融股則有賣壓，資金向少數大型權值股集中。

法人認為，台股創高後難免出現震盪，且中秋連假將至，預期觀望氣氛會轉趨濃厚，若操作偏短線，可以考慮獲利了結，長線投資者仍可汰弱留強，尤其第四季一直都是股市表現較好的時刻。

摩爾投顧分析師林漢偉指出，今日台股挑戰歷史新高，美股全面收漲，加上台指期夜盤大漲728點，電子權值股買氣明顯升溫。外資現貨連三買、期貨空單持續減少，中小型股同步補漲，今天重點觀察指數補量後能否上演軋空行情。

news.Title: 導入台積電2奈米　創意HBM4E矽智財設計定案AI晶片採用
news.Content:
（中央社記者張建中新竹2026年09月22日電）特殊應用晶片（ASIC）廠創意電子 (3443) 今天宣布，HBM4E實體層（PHY）與控制器矽智財（IP）已完成設計定案，並獲客戶人工智慧（AI）ASIC採用。

創意今天發布新聞稿表示，旗下HBM4E PHY與控制器IP是採用台積電最先進的強化版2奈米（N2P）製程與CoWoS-L封裝技術。

創意指出，HBM4E IP可將資料傳輸速度提升至16Gbps，同時提供領先業界的功耗效率與超小面積。透過專有的矽中介層（interposer）布線技術，這IP針對訊號完整性與電源完整性進行最佳化，並可支援多種台積電CoWoS封裝架構。

為支援3D系統整合單晶片（SoIC）架構，創意表示，HBM4E IP提供專為台積電SoIC-X技術設計的face-up版本。IP整合專用矽穿孔（TSVs），以支援訊號輸出與輸入，以及向上層晶片提供電源，為複雜的3D整合架構建立完整的連接路徑。

創意指出，HBM4E在頻寬與系統層級效能方面，為新一代AI加速器帶來重大突破。透過整合創意的face-up HBM、face-up UCIe與GLink-3D IP，創意提供完整的3D SoIC架構介面IP解決方案，使客戶能夠無縫整合HBM、小晶片（Chiplet）與3D堆疊，並充分發揮最先進製程技術的效能。

news.Title: 台股選股新浪潮，台新臺灣中小主動式ETF基金10/5開募
news.Content:
【財訊快報／記者劉居全報導】台新投信指出，回顧2026年，市場聚焦權值股，使得台股投資以「買方向」為優先並重壓權值股；展望2027年，台股獲利增速換檔與供應鏈分化，超額報酬核心將由「題材上漲」走向「獲利兌現與企業差異」，將造就台股主動選股新浪潮，ETF資金漸往小股本靠攏，中小股本公司更有表現空間。台新投信率先業界推出國內首檔聚焦中小股本的台股主動式ETF「台新臺灣中小主動式ETF基金(00416A)」，將於10月5日開始募集，為投資人掌握中小利基股的長線爆發力行情。台新臺灣中小主動式ETF基金經理人沈建宏表示，美國期中選舉將於11月舉行，根據歷史經驗來看，在美國總統任期中，美股在第二年期中選舉前半年呈現低報酬、高波動特徵，但隨著民調逐漸明朗，市場信心在接近選舉日及選後快速修復，加上2027年美股企業獲利持續成長，配合往年大選前一年通常是總統任期內股市表現最佳的一年，預期第四季美股有望重啟漲勢，屆時台股追隨美股節奏，延續2027年的多頭行情。而根據統計，美國期中選舉後三月、六月與一年之台股報酬，股本低於80億的中小型股平均報酬皆優於股本大於80億的大型股。

台新臺灣中小主動式ETF基金是目前國內唯一高度鎖定股本80億以下、基本面強、成長潛力佳的個股的台股主動式ETF。主要是看好小股本籌碼輕，更具股價爆發力，運用經理人洞察好時機，主動挖掘基本面強，未來具成長潛力的小股本公司，完整布局台灣六大AI浪潮優勢產業鏈。沈建宏表示，高盛證券預估，AI算力需求將以每年約400%的速度爆發式增長，AI仍在成長趨勢上，台股企業獲利2026~2027年增率皆有20%以上的成長，台股後市仍有機會創新高，中小利基股表現可望勝出。

news.Title: 聯發科推個人運算新平台 首款3奈米旗艦晶片導入Googlebook
news.Content:
聯發科(2454-TW)今(22)日推出全新Dimensity個人運算(Compute Experiences；CX)系列平台的首款旗艦SoC Dimensity CX C10 Max，其採用台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US) 3奈米製程，為即將上市的高階、超便攜Googlebook提供卓越性能、先進功能，以及出色能效。

聯發科Dimensity CX C10 Max 搭載全大核8核心CPU、11核心GPU，以及自家第8代NPU，透過高性能平台架構，在多工任務、生產力應用、智慧輔助、娛樂等多元應用場景中提供優異性能；其節能架構可協助製造商設計出更輕薄、無風扇且具備全天候續航力的裝置。

聯發科NPU 890提供最高可達55 TOPS的性能，讓即將上市的Googlebook能提供更主動且智慧的服務。延續聯發科技橫跨邊緣到雲端的AI技術領導地位，NPU 890專為支援Gemini Intelligence功能設計，不僅帶來更快速的回應速度，也帶來更完善的隱私保護。

聯發科資深副總經理暨數據中心與運算事業群總經理Vince Hu表示，Dimensity CX C10 Max是專為下一波智慧運算需求所打造，透過結合旗艦性能與高能效運算技術，確保在帶來絕佳的使用者體驗的同時，也能擁有優異的電池續航力。透過將這些強大的運算能力擴展至Googlebook，聯發科技不僅彰顯在Android運算領域的領先優勢，更延續與 Google長久以來的深厚合作夥伴關係。

聯發科技Dimensity CX C10 Max整合Imagiq 1090 ISP，提供業界頂尖的專業級相機畫質，該款AI-ISP支援高達3200萬畫素相機感測器，並以此實現高品質HDR影片拍攝、流暢變焦、電影級畫面，以及持續對焦不中斷等功能，為視訊通話、直播、內容創作帶來更清晰、更具沉浸感的體驗。

此平台支援Wi-Fi 7連線，提供高達7.3Gbps的傳輸速度，即便在訊號繁忙的無線環境下，也能為影音串流、下載、視訊會議提供高速可靠的連線品質；此外，也支援雙引擎藍牙6.0，提供無線周邊裝置與音訊設備高效的連線。

Dimensity CX C10 Max透過整合全大核CPU、強勁GPU以及具備Agentic AI加速能力的業界領先NPU，以因應最嚴苛且繁重的運算任務，並賦予使用者超高速多工處理能力，最大化其生產力。

news.Title: Meta Stock Is Still Too Cheap
news.Content:
On Friday, I called Meta Platforms' (NASDAQ:META) new AI personal agent, Muse, a game changer for the company. I didn't expect that would happen as soon as the next trading day.

Meta stock soared 11.4% on Monday after a Wells Fargo analyst raised his price target on the stock from $640 to $796, noting the success of the Muse Spark LLM and the new Muse assistant, and investors also seemed to react to Muse achieving the top spot in Apple's App Store.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 15x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Muse was released two weeks ago, but Wall Street suddenly seems to be waking up to its impact, even though it's been clear that the AI agent has been rapidly gaining adoption, with 600,000 downloads in the first five days after its release.

Today, the tailwinds from Meta's surge were strong enough to lift the broader AI sector, with CPU stocks like Arm , Intel , and AMD all soaring on the news, since agentic AI is closely tied to CPU demand. If Meta has the first breakout AI agent, CPU stocks are likely to benefit as AI agent usage drives more demand.

Image source: The Motley Fool.

What it means for Meta

With Monday's gain, Meta is now up 21% since Muse was launched, and the stock could have more room to run.

Investors have long been skeptical of Meta's AI strategy, especially as it's been losing close to $20 billion a year on Reality Labs, but the social media giant could have a big winner on its hands in Muse. The early response, with 600,000 downloads, is not unlike what ChatGPT experienced after its launch, and the reviews for Muse have been glowing as well.

CEO Mark Zuckerberg explained his commitment to free access, saying, 'We think that this thing is actually going to make you money and save you money, and that is how it's going to pay for itself."

Meta is already entrenched in social media, with roughly half the world as its user base. It's a key player in digital advertising and e-commerce, making it will positioned to monetize an AI agent , and Wall Street now appears to recognize that. Meta is charging $20-$100/month for Muse's premium tiers, but if the company can make Muse a must-have product, there will be plenty of ways to monetize it.

Finally, Meta has the potential to follow in Alphabet's footsteps, which soared after its Gemini LLM proved to be a serious competitor to OpenAI and Anthropic, with the stock essentially doubling in the second half of last year.

Story Continues

Meta is still a bargain

Meta has long traded at a discount relative to its growth rate. There's no simple reason for that, but investors seem to believe that the company isn't diversified beyond advertising, it faces regulatory threats, including the $17 billion settlement related to unsafe content for children, and it's burned a ton of money on AI, leading some investors to question Zuckerberg's instincts after the metaverse flop.

Currently, the stock trades at a price-to-earnings ratio of 25, which is still cheaper than the S&P 500 , but the company is expected to grow much faster than the broad-market index. Meta is on track to grow revenue by 26.5% this year to $254.1 billion, and that doesn't include any impact from Muse, which could accelerate its growth in the fourth quarter and into next year.

Even without Muse, Meta stock looks cheap given its consistently strong growth in the core advertising business, but now the company looks poised to be a major player in AI thanks to Muse. If the momentum in Muse adoption continues, Meta could hit a $1,000 a share by the end of the year.

news.Title: 盤中刷48,601點新高！友達、欣興、元晶大噴發「中小股怎麼倒一片？」專家：高檔操作只能抓緊這族群
news.Content: 台股今（22）日迎來歷史性的瘋狂行情！受到美股全面噴發、AI族群再度集體高潮激勵，加權指數早盤以47,981.04點開出後，隨即在半導體與核心權值股瘋狂買盤湧入下多頭氣勢如虹，指數一路急拉，盤中最高狂飆882.69點，觸及48,601.53點，一舉突破前波48,218點高點，成功刷新歷史盤中新高紀錄。 美股科技股凌厲漲勢成強心針 市場分析師指出，台股強勢表態主要承接美股科技股凌厲漲勢，由於國際油價與美債殖利率雙雙走低，全球資金環境不確定性大幅降低，風險偏好顯著回升；美國那斯達克指數大漲逾2％，費城半導體指數更瘋狂噴發4.29％，其中台積電ADR勁揚2.41％，直接為台股早盤注入強心針，帶動亞洲半導體重鎮拉開強勢反彈序幕。 今日盤面資金高度集中於AI晶片、先進製程及ABF載板等供應鏈，成為推升指數的最大功臣。權值王台積電（2330）早盤最高觸及2,510元，大漲30元；IC設計龍頭聯發科（2454）買盤瘋狂噴發，最高衝上5,480元新天價，盤中大漲逾8％；封測大廠日月光投控（3711）同樣獲資金大舉追捧，盤中大漲超過6％，最高來到711元；電源管理大廠台達電（2308）則受外資調升目標價刺激，大漲90元至1,965元。 股王領軍強攻漲停，高價題材股百花齊放 更令市場矚目的是高價股與題材股的亮眼表現，「股王」信驊（5274）受惠AI需求極度強勁，開盤即跳空亮燈漲停，飆破21,800元大關，個股股價與單日上漲金額均創下歷史新高；ABF載板大廠欣興（3037）在強勁營收業績支撐與外資大舉買超下，股價跳空鎖住1,120元漲停板。此外，受馬斯克看好太陽能言論激勵，太陽能概念股元晶（6443）、安集（6477）、倉和（6492）全面大漲，元晶、倉和強攻漲停。面板大廠友達（2409）也因應大陸面板廠聯合減產調價利多，爆量封鎖漲停。 然而，在大型權值股專屬的舞台下，今日盤面資金排擠效應極為嚴重，呈現「賺了指數、部分中小型股卻挨打」的兩極化走勢。記憶體大廠南亞科（2408）開紅盤後遭逢高檔技術反壓與資金排擠，盤中由紅翻黑下殺逾2.5％；先前漲幅極大的半導體測試介面族群更淪為投信與法人獲利了結的重災區，指標股穎崴（6515）盤中重摔跌停，均華（6640）與鴻勁（6969）等個股跌幅亦均在5％以上。 指標券商看好第四季衝刺52,000點 針對台股創下歷史新高的瘋狂行情，各大投顧與資深分析師看法普遍維持「長線極度樂觀、短線保持理性」的基調。 富邦投顧董事長陳奕光長線抱持多頭看法，並指出，今年上市櫃企業稅後純益上看7.8兆元，年增高達7成以上。隨著四大雲端服務供應商（CSP）持續上修資本支出，AI基本面極為穩固，接下來10月14日的台積電法說會將是關鍵轉折點，若第三季財報如預期衝高，台股第四季高點有機會進一步衝刺52,000點；統一證券、國票證券等機構也一致認為，隨著美國升息利空出盡，第四季AI旺季行情已正式開跑。 不過，在短線技術面上，資深證券分析師蔡明翰提醒，台股創高必須守穩前高48,218點，維持「價漲量增」才是相對健康的訊號。由於本周五起即將迎來中秋節及教師節長假，統一投顧董事長黎方國與啟發投顧分析師郭憲政皆提出警訊，指數在逼近歷史高檔與整數關卡時，極容易引發短線獲利了結的劇烈震盪，投資人此時切忌盲目追高。 擇優布局實質基本面中大型AI權值股 前日盛投顧總經理、股市趨勢大師鍾國忠更直言，今年大盤至今的漲幅已大幅跑贏企業基本面的獲利成長速度，股價不可能永遠與基本面脫鉤，並強烈建議，投資人在此歷史高點應採取「適度獲利收成、保留現金」的防守策略，並耐心等待盤勢回檔，操作上應擇優布局流動性佳、具備實質基本面支撐的中大型AI權值股，以避開部分中小型股缺乏資金關照的修正風險。

news.Title: 不只台積電受惠！ 瑞銀上修CoWoS產能 一口氣喊買11台廠
news.Content:
雲端AI需求強勁，自研晶片與CPU爆發驅動CoWoS先進封裝產能大擴張！瑞銀最新報告看好台積電、聯發科及設備供應鏈，獲利與目標價全面看升。

雲端AI需求帶動產能升級

根據瑞銀證券最新發布的研究報告顯示，隨著雲端AI晶片需求持續暢旺，特別是各大廠商自研晶片（ASIC）與CPU的量產進程加速，業界對CoWoS先進封裝產能的需求顯著提升。瑞銀預計到2027年底，CoWoS月產能將達到27萬片，超越先前預期的26萬片，相較2026年底的16萬片呈現大幅成長。即便英特爾的EMIB-T與台積電的COPOS逐步量產，CoWoS在大型AI加速器中的不可替代性依然穩固。

客製化晶片突破拉動封裝需求

經過多年的技術投資，各大雲端業者與AI原生企業在客製化晶片領域陸續取得突破。微軟Maia 300效能表現具競爭力，預計產量將大幅上升；OpenAI與Meta也同步調升產量目標。此外，Google TPU與亞馬遜Trainium專案均穩健推進，這些進展進一步拉動了對先進封裝的強勁成長需求。

台廠先進封裝供應鏈全面受惠

在雲端AI半導體供應鏈中，瑞銀首選台積電、聯發科與日月光投控作為核心標的。其中，聯發科不僅提供Google TPU設計服務，更具備強大的新ASIC商機。瑞銀預估包含先進封裝在內的後段製程，將佔台積電2026與2027年營收的12%與16%，其先進封裝營收在2026至2030年間，將維持約50%的年複合成長率。

同時，先進封測設備商與相關供應鏈也直接受惠於產能擴張與封裝結構複雜化。瑞銀看好的台廠業者包含萬潤、弘塑、致茂、鴻勁、信驊及世芯-KY。針對弘塑，瑞銀雖然考量2026年設備交機認列減少與平均售價下修，將其目標價由5000元調降至4300元並下修EPS預測，但考量其仍為先進封裝擴產的主要受惠者，依然維持「買進」評等。

news.Title: 台股再刷盤中新高 登48601點
news.Content:
全球各主要央行升息暫告一段落，市場也逐漸消化「AI末日論」。美股四大指數全面反彈，台北股市今天(22日)一開盤就突破前波高點48,218點，大漲近900點，來到48,601點的新高位，再度改寫歷史盤中新高。

美國最新公布7月CPI數據顯著降溫，引發市場對聯準會按兵不動與未來降息的樂觀預期，美國科技股與亞洲半導體重鎮同步拉開強勢反彈序幕。

根據瑞士銀行(UBS)的研究報告，大幅上調全球AI資本支出預測，預估至2026年全球AI資本支出將逼近1兆美元大關。大華銀投信指數量化投資部門主管郭修誠指出，瑞銀等國際機構上調資本支出預估，證實全球科技巨頭對AI基礎建設的投資絲毫未減，反而因記憶體價格勁揚與設備升級而持續擴大支出規模，不僅奠定未來數年的高成長格局，更將推升AI硬體產業鏈邁向2027年的高速AI黃金期。

在美股四大指數全面反彈激勵下，台北股市22日一開盤就突破前波高點48,218點，大漲近900點，來到48,601點的新高位，再度改寫歷史盤中新高。

萬寶投顧執行長王榮旭也指出，全球各主要央行升息已暫告一段落，日前傳出的「AI末日論」，近期輝達等相關科技AI巨頭都陸續出面釋疑，市場也逐漸消化科技類股利空。以目前來看，各界擔心的通膨，近期在油價回跌，再加上美伊高層有望這週會面，都讓市場情緒轉趨樂觀。且從期程來看，時序邁入第四季，11月初美國又將舉行期中選舉，在外資回流下，台股看來也正逐步挑戰登上5萬點的歷史大關。王榮旭說：『(原音)今天預估量1.1兆是配合指數過前高，所以指數過前高有超過1兆以上的大量，代表就是籌碼在高檔換手的一個狀況是不錯。今天除非尾盤殺下來，要不然的話如果能夠收高就是量價俱揚，配合指數過高以及籌碼良性換手，這是有利行情繼續的往上漲。』

台北金融市場22日呈現股匯雙漲格局。在台股創新高下，新台幣兌美元匯價盤中一度大幅升值近1角，突破31.7元大關，來到31.66元，近午盤時又回到31.7元價位附近游走。

news.Title: 智慧戒指大廠Oura赴美IPO 估值挑戰156億美元
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-09-22 11:38:32 李彥瑾 發佈

芬蘭智慧戒指大廠Oura 21日正式啟動IPO法人說明會（Roadshow），計劃與現有股東合計出售5,000萬股，每股發行價格區間40至44美元，最高可募資22億美元。若計入已發行股票、認股選擇權等潛在股份的稀釋效果，完全稀釋估值上看156.2億美元。

路透社報導，Oura預計最快下週公布IPO定價，並以股票代號「OURA」掛牌那斯達克交易所。近期因AI題材熱度降溫、美債殖利率走高，加上Fed政策預期反覆，市場風險偏好轉趨謹慎，Oura IPO案也被視為美股IPO市況的重要風向球。

Oura於2013年在芬蘭創立，公司總部位於美國舊金山，主力產品為智慧戒指Oura Ring。相較智慧手錶，智慧戒指體積更小、重量更輕，長時間配戴較無異物感，非常適合用來追蹤心率、睡眠狀況及活動量等健康數據。

隨著健康自主管理風氣盛行，智慧戒指市場近年快速崛起，也挹注Oura營運規模擴張。截至2026年6月30日，Oura付費會員數達500萬人；Oura預估2026會計年度終了將增至570萬人，年增96%。

截至2026年6月30日的12個月期間，智慧戒指Oura Ring銷量累計達360萬枚；截至6月30日的9個月期間，營收達12.1億美元，年增74%。

製藥巨頭禮來（Eli Lilly）已表態有意以不超過1億美元的額度認購股份，投資機構Dragoneer亦有意認購至多3億美元。

news.Title: 【台股盤中】台股創高電子強勢　高價股多檔漲停
news.Content:
（中央社記者潘智義台北2026年9月22日電）美股齊揚，科技股大漲，帶動台股今天早盤漲882點，重新站上48000點大關，最高達48601點，創歷史新高，隨後漲勢稍見收斂。電子股強勢，大型權值股上揚，高價股多檔漲停。

11時13分左右，加權指數為48173點，上漲454點，漲幅0.95%，成交金額新台幣6864億元。

台積電 (2330) 早盤達2510元，漲30元，盤中回到2500元之下。聯發科 (2454) 漲470元至5480元後漲勢收斂，台達電 (2308) 為1965元上揚90元；鴻海 (2317) 達253元，漲3元。

股王信驊 (5274) 跳空漲停達21800元，站上2萬元大關，創台股新紀錄；萬元股川湖 (2059) 盤中達13305元；創意 (3443) 盤中也漲停達8375元；千金股嘉澤 (3533) 、南電 (8046) 、欣興 (3037) 都漲停，分別為1745元、1165元、1120元。

新掛牌高價股漢測 (7856) 盤中達4995元，勁揚逾1.22倍。

面板雙虎轉型跨入微型發光二極體（MicroLED）、先進封裝製程受市場矚目，傳聞英特爾將攜手友達 (2409) 投入先進封裝市場，友達繼昨天漲停，今天盤中也高掛漲停價36.65元；已領先反映一段轉型行情的群創 (3481) 則上揚3.57%至52.2元。

news.Title: Tencent Releases AI Image Model to Catch ByteDance, Alibaba
news.Content:
(Bloomberg) -- Tencent Holdings Ltd. launched its latest and best image-generation model on the same day as rival Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. kicked off its AI conference, signaling intent to catch up to industry leaders like ByteDance Ltd.

Most Read from Bloomberg

Paramount to Settle Lawsuits, Paving Way for Warner Bros.

Qatar Energy Chief Says Bessent 'Wrong' About Hormuz Future

Stocks Jump on AI Optimism as AMD Tops $1 Trillion: Markets Wrap

AI Risk Is Everywhere and It's Making Billion Dollar Funds Nervous

US and China Hail Talks as Positive Ahead of Trump-Xi Summit

The Hy Image 3.5 Preview model offers a performance boost over its predecessor and is being integrated across Tencent products, including the Yuanbao chatbot and film-editing and design tools, the company said in a statement Tuesday.

The release shows Tencent accelerating its exploration of applications beyond text, while working toward its vision of building AI that performs tasks for the billion-plus users of its WeChat ecosystem. Meta Platforms Inc.'s agent-centric Muse this week shot to the top of download charts on mobile app stores — underscoring interest in an agentic AI that can tailor content for users and help them carry out tasks like shopping and hailing rides. Tencent's shares gained more than 7% in Hong Kong.

"Some investors are drawing parallels between Tencent and Meta, particularly given WeChat's unique social ecosystem and its potential to support a personal AI assistant at scale," said Gary Tan, portfolio manager at Allspring Global Investments.

The Chinese social media and gaming conglomerate has lagged Big Tech peers in delivering boundary-pushing large language models. It recently hired former OpenAI researcher Yao Shunyu, who overhauled the company's AI infrastructure and benchmarking standards. Yao, who now serves as chief AI scientist, has publicly criticized training models solely for the sake of leaderboard scores, saying Tencent will instead focus on product integration and solving real-world problems.

The company has also continued to attract top talent since hiring Yao. Tian Yonglong, a former OpenAI researcher specializing in computer vision, joined Tencent in July and now leads vision-language models under the Hunyuan team.

Shenzhen-based Tencent tested the Hy Image 3.5 Preview among hundreds of in-house designers, and said that the model achieved results on par with ByteDance's Seedream 5.0 Pro. The new Hy Image model is slightly better than Nano Banana Pro from Alphabet Inc.'s Google and Qwen-Image-3.0 Pro from Alibaba, the company added. Tencent employs thousands of game designers and artists, who may benefit from the tool, though it didn't quantify its quality claims.

news.Title: 股市Q4表現不俗 近5年台股平均漲幅居全球之冠
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-09-22 11:07:20 新聞中心 發佈

過完中秋假期後，時序也將進入第四季，第四季在節慶效應加持下，向來為全球傳統消費旺季，過往經驗來看股市表現亦多不俗。統計近五年全球主要股市於第四季平均表現，整體來看漲多跌少，前十強股市平均都有超過3%的表現，當中又以台股表現最佳，加權指數平均漲幅近7.67%，緊接著為美股，標普500指數上漲6.68%亦是亮眼，其他包括日本、法國、韓國等也有好於4%的漲幅，投資人不妨善用相關ETF或基金加以布局，把握投資契機。

主動群益核心50 (00415A)經理人許育誌表示，聯準會於最新FOMC會議中決議升息一碼，結束前(2024)年9月以來的降息循環，決策符合市場預期，市場焦點也重回基本面評估，預期基本面佳的區域與產業仍足以抵禦利率上行風險。鑒於台灣經濟保持穩健，加上AI需求強勁，尤其在企業資本支出持續向上，以及相關應用持續落地下，長期發展明確，台系供應鏈因在當中扮演關鍵技術與零組件生產要角，仍有望持續受惠，故對於台股後市仍正向看待，惟在資金輪動的環境下，建議投資人可運用能靈活調整持股的主動式市值台股ETF來掌握行情。

群益S&P500 (009823)經理人謝明志指出，美國經濟活動持續以穩健步調擴張。儘管地緣政治情勢等因素使經濟前景仍籠罩高度不確定性，但國內支出保持韌性，生產力成長強勁，企業獲利前景仍佳，獲利預估上修的企業範圍持續擴大，顯示基本面與獲利面仍能支持美股表現，而在美股題材多元、資金於各類股間健康輪動下，建議投資人不妨善用廣泛布局各產業的市值型美股ETF來參與行情。其中，追蹤標普500指數因成分股組成廣泛，涵蓋近9九成的美股總市值，布局追蹤該指數的美股ETF形同於布局全產業美股，全方位掌握美股行情。

群益東方盛世基金經理人洪玉婷表示，日本企業獲利展現韌性，排除關稅退還與匯率等一次性因素後，今年4月至6月企業獲利年增約9.3%，銀行受惠於升息、非鐵金屬受惠原物料上漲，AI概念股則受惠AI需求強勁，故市場預期日本今年度企業獲利可望成長近19%，此外，日本企業股票回購金額已達去年全年水準，企業亦持續透過出售交叉持股、提高股利與回購強化股東回饋，外資亦具備回補空間，故在獲利面與資金面都屬正向，且經濟持穩，皆有助於日股表現。

news.Title: 漢測正式掛牌上櫃　承銷價 2,250 元創台股史上新高
news.Content:
【緯來新聞網】半導體測試設備廠漢測（7856）今（22）日正式上櫃掛牌，以每股 2,250 元的承銷價創下台股史上最高紀錄。掛牌之際，漢測也交出亮眼的營收成績單：今年 1 至 8 月累計營收達新台幣 31.70 億元、年增 125.94％，已超越 2025 年全年 24.25 億元的規模；隨客製化產品比重提升，近年獲利成長幅度也高於營收成長。

圖／漢測提供

漢測於 2004 年的成立，深耕半導體測試領域，業務涵蓋探針卡與清潔材料、半導體設備與客製化產品，以及工程服務三大領域，同時也是日系晶圓針測機（Prober）大廠的合作夥伴，負責原廠設備的裝機、移機、改機與技術維護。

漢測總經理王子建表示，公司的服務並非僅止於單次設備交付，而是從設備裝機、客製化套件整合與運轉維護，一路延伸至耗材與模組供應，形成完整的服務鏈；隨客戶廠內設備數量增加，公司也能透過第一線服務經驗掌握需求，逐步將客製化方案轉化為可複製、可量產的標準化產品。

這套服務鏈的背後，是漢測以輕資產策略布建的全球服務網絡，目前已涵蓋台灣新竹與台南、中國蘇州、日本東京與熊本，以及馬來西亞、新加坡與美國。王子建說明，隨全球半導體供應鏈區域化趨勢明確，客戶在美國、日本與東南亞的新產能陸續開出，貼近客戶的工程團隊與應變能力，成為承接需求的重要條件；相較於重資產模式，輕資產布局可降低前期投資，也能更快跟隨客戶腳步落地。

除了既有的晶圓測試業務，漢測近年也把觸角伸向高速記憶體 SLT、先進封裝設備，以及矽光子 CPO（共同封裝光學）測試三項新市場。其中，漢測近期與光子自動化設備業者 ficonTEC 展開合作，鎖定 CPO 由研發走向商業化過程中衍生的測試需求，結合 ficonTEC 在光子自動化與設備整合的技術，以及漢測在晶圓級測試系統組裝、工程支援與 OEM 及 ODM 客製化的能力。

談到這項合作，王子建認為，這展現了雙方在技術能力與實務經驗上的互補：ficonTEC 專注於矽光子測試設備開發，具備光電自動化相關技術；未來雙方將共同因應精密對位、光電整合等矽光子測試挑戰，協助客戶縮短從開發驗證到生產應用的導入時程。

法人分析，隨先進製程、先進封裝與高速傳輸技術持續推升測試複雜度，測試環節在半導體價值鏈中的重要性將持續提升，漢測掛牌後的三大新市場布局，也將是後續觀察其成長動能的重點。

news.Title: 費半狂漲4％ 台股大漲逾8百點衝48601點 中秋前創歷史新高
news.Content:
【緯來新聞網】

美股走揚，費城半導體指數更大漲逾4.3％，四大指數全面收漲，韓股週二也跟著狂歡，在三星電子漲近5%帶動，指數漲逾2%，而台股則在台積電、聯發科、聯電等電子股開盤大漲，台股今（22日）以47981點開出，指數上漲262點，隨後指數持續上漲，一度大漲882點至48601點，一舉越過先前高點48218點，在中秋前夕創下歷史新高。

費半狂飆激勵台股一度大漲882點至48601點，一舉越過先前高點48218點，在中秋前夕創下歷史新高。（圖／緯來財經提供）

在晶圓雙雄掌兵權，AI、 ABF載板、IC設計、矽智財、低軌衛星、矽晶圓、光電等電子股全力衝刺，加上傳產與金融助攻，指數開高走高。台積電（2330）開盤上漲25元來到2505元，最高來到2510元；聯發科（2454）延續上攻動能，大漲超過8％，最高來到5480元；ABF族群欣興（3037）、南電（8046）雙雙亮燈漲停；面板股友達（2409）一度漲停，傳出英特爾有意攜手友達推先進封裝，爆出68萬張大量。

興櫃股王、半導體測試介面廠漢測（7856）也在今日（22日）上櫃，以每股2,250元掛牌，最多上漲逾110％，盤中來到4780元，由於搭上人工智慧（AI）、高效能運算（HPC）晶片測試需求爆發商機，股價表現強勢；今日千金股與萬金股表現火燙，信驊（5274）跳空開高開盤漲停，來到21800元，事台股首檔股價突破2萬元的公司；川湖（2059）也反彈超過3％重回13000元。但老AI股表現相對弱勢，緯創（3231）、緯穎（6669）、廣達（2382）多在盤下震盪。

今年市場條件與過往並不完全相同，包括貨幣政策、利率調整等因素已提前反映，本周還有川習會登場，加上台股先前已經歷大幅修正，市場賣壓相對降低，因此中秋節前出現劇烈反轉的可能性較低。

news.Title: Coinbase開放IPO配售，美國散戶申購新股
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-09-22 10:43:31 數位內容中心 發佈

加密資產交易平台Coinbase（COIN.US）於2026年9月21日宣布，將向符合資格的美國散戶開放首次公開發行股票配售，讓用戶可在股票於公開市場開始交易前，依發行價格申請認購。

news.Title: 聯發科旗艦級Dimensity CX C10 Max晶片上市，強攻高階Googlebook
news.Content:
【財訊快報／記者李純君報導】針對NB筆電平台，採台積電(2330)3奈米產出，晶片設計龍頭聯發科(2454)今（22）日推出全新Dimensity個人運算（Compute Experiences；CX）系列平台的首款旗艦SoC－Dimensity CX C10 Max，主要將內建在上市的高階、超便攜Googlebook中。聯發科Dimensity CX C10 Max採用台積電3奈米先進製程，搭載全大核8核心CPU、11核心GPU，以及聯發科第8代NPU，透過高性能平台架構，在多工任務、生產力應用、智慧輔助、娛樂等多元應用場景中提供優異性能；其節能架構可協助製造商設計出更輕薄、無風扇且具備全天候續航力的裝置。

聯發科NPU 890提供最高可達55 TOPS的性能，讓即將上市的Googlebook能提供更主動且智慧的服務。延續聯發科橫跨邊緣到雲端的AI技術領導地位，聯發科 NPU 890專為支援Gemini Intelligence功能設計，不僅帶來更快速的回應速度，也帶來更完善的隱私保護。

聯發科資深副總經理暨數據中心與運算事業群總經理Vince Hu表示，Dimensity CX C10 Max是專為下一波智慧運算需求所打造，透過結合旗艦性能與高能效運算技術，確保在帶來絕佳的使用者體驗的同時，也能擁有優異的電池續航力。透過將這些強大的運算能力擴展至Googlebook，聯發科延續在Android運算領域的優勢，與Google長久以來的深厚合作夥伴關係。

聯發科Dimensity CX C10 Max整合Imagiq 1090 ISP，提供業界頂尖的專業級相機畫質，該款AI-ISP支援高達3200萬畫素相機感測器，並以此實現高品質HDR影片拍攝、流暢變焦、電影級畫面，以及持續對焦不中斷等功能，為視訊通話、直播、內容創作帶來更清晰、更具沉浸感的體驗。

此平台支援Wi-Fi 7連線，提供高達7.3Gbps的傳輸速度，即便在訊號繁忙的無線環境下，也能為影音串流、下載、視訊會議提供高速可靠的連線品質；此外，也支援雙引擎藍牙6.0，提供無線周邊裝置與音訊設備高效的連線。

news.Title: 電子高價、封測、CCL、ABF、面板同步上漲，台股指數領先創新高
news.Content:
【財訊快報／方亞申】美國費半指數大漲，以CPU為主的英特爾、AMD、ARM全面上漲超過9%以上，晶片股普遍上揚，指標美國10年期公債殖利率跌回具有重要心理意義的5%關口之下。布蘭特原油期貨盤中跌破每桶100美元等等，一反過去幾週都是利空較多，四大指數全面大漲，那指創歷史新高，刺激台股週二盤中創歷史新高達48601點。電子股高價及矽智財股主攻，封測、面板、ABF、金控雙雄紛紛上漲，進塑化股拉回，預估成交值量超過1兆，多頭趨勢可望持續進行。Meta平台新推出的消費級AI智能體Muse迅速走紅，也令市場重新評估智能體普及帶來的運算需求，帶動CPU概念股全面上揚。Meta股價大漲11%，AMD上漲9%、收在615美元，總市值首度突破1兆美元。Meta目前是AMD第2大客戶，貢獻約5.5%營收。雙方今年2月宣布擴大合作，Meta計劃部署最多6GW的AMD Instinct GPU，首批支援1GW部署的產品預計2026年下半年出貨，並採用以MI450架構為基礎的客製化晶片。Arm預估2030年市場規模可達1,200億美元；AMD則上看2,200億美元。英特爾執行長陳立武上週也表示，公司目前僅能滿足約50%的客戶需求，CPU供應緊張仍將持續。這次半導體主軸轉向CPU。此外，谷歌、亞馬遜、輝達等高總市值公司股價也緩步上升。那指這次創歷史次高，一反今年以來的弱勢。短線只要四大指數站穩10日線上就屬強勢。

台股8月份以來除少數電子股向上推升外，有台塑集團及金融股掩護推升，到了9月以後又轉換成電子股。這次晶圓代工的台積電(2330)、聯電(2303)、世界(5347)表現都不錯。矽智財則由高價股創意(3443)創高，聯發科(2454)跟進，信驊(5274)股價也登上2萬元創高，川湖(2059)、大立光(3008)、漢測(7856)、世芯-KY(3661)、力旺(3529)、台光電(2383)以及ABF的欣興(3037)、南電(8046)、臻鼎-KY(4958)、景碩(3189)，加上散熱的富世達(6805)、健策(3653)表現都不錯。

封測族群強勢，日月光投控(3711)幾乎創高，矽格(6257)、力成(6239)、欣銓(3264)、東華(8110)、京元電子(2449)、南茂(8150)等都屬強勢。矽晶圓及被動元件以及台積電耗材中砂(1560)、昇陽半導體(8028)、精材(3374)。傳統半導體績優股瑞昱(2379)、聯詠(3034)及廠務的聖暉*(5536)、漢唐(2404)表現也不錯。面板股友達(2409)因為富采(3714)買進大漲，群創(3481)跟進。

油價下跌，加上官員對本週四將登場的「川習會」釋放樂觀信號，油價下跌，台塑四寶下跌，記憶體也拉回。金融股富邦金(2881)及國泰金(2882)穩健上漲。

台股指數領先費半及韓國指數創歷史新高，主要是有強勁本面，目前短中期均線集結在47000點上下，轉為強烈支撐。

news.Title: Sandisk has $93.9 billion in deals: Now comes the hard part
news.Content:
Sandisk (SNDK) has become one of the more unusual beneficiaries of the artificial-intelligence boom.

The company is not making the processors that power AI models. Instead, it is supplying something those systems increasingly need: storage .

This differentiation has grown more significant as AI data centers increase and workloads move to inference, agentic AI, and other applications that demand fast storage and access to massive volumes of data.

Sandisk's recent figures indicate exactly how fast the industry has transformed. The business said sales in the fiscal fourth quarter were $8.97 billion, above the $8.39 billion expected, according to Reuters . Data-center revenue more than quadrupled from the preceding quarter to $2.98 billion.

Sandisk also said it currently has eight long-term contracts for $93.9 billion or more with six clients, Reuters also reported. The average contract period is four years, and the company anticipates that half of the company's output will be under such contracts in fiscal 2027 and two-thirds in fiscal 2028.

That change is built into the stock. Sandisk finished at $1,791.82 on Sept. 18 , up 11% that day and 6.2% the previous session.

But there's a catch: The same AI boom driving Sandisk's growth is tightening NAND supplies, attracting new competitors and forcing memory companies to make difficult decisions about where to allocate capacity.

Sandisk's AI opportunity is becoming a storage story

Sandisk's fiscal 2026 results show why investors are paying attention.

Data center storage has become a major growth pillar , the firm said, and its larger business includes corporate solid-state drives, client storage, and consumer goods.

Q4 FY2026 revenue: $8.97 billion

Q4 data-center revenue: $2.98 billion

Long-term agreements: 8

Customers covered: 6

Contract value: At least $93.9 billion

New buyback authorization: $14 billion

Q1 FY2027 revenue outlook: $10.3 billion to $10.8 billion

The fourth-quarter revenue from data centers of $2.98 billion is particularly important because it demonstrates the speed with which the mix is changing.

Related: Micron, SanDisk get new aggressive price targets from top analyst

Data centers need more storage and processing capacity, which is creating demand for Sandisk's enterprise solid-state drives and flash memory chips, Reuters noted.

The projection for the upcoming quarter also suggests ongoing progress for the firm.

Sandisk expects fiscal first-quarter 2027 revenue of $10.3 billion to $10.8 billion , with non-GAAP diluted earnings of $44 to $46 per share.

Story Continues

The NAND market is giving Sandisk more pricing power

Sandisk is experiencing a very timely growth period in the NAND cycle.

North American cloud-service providers had lately revised upward their predictions for business SSD demand. The research group anticipates that enterprise SSD orders will surpass already-high third-quarter levels in the fourth quarter.

Increased demand is also giving NAND suppliers more influence over capacity allocation and pricing, which supports future hikes in enterprise SSD costs, as TrendForce reported.

The enterprise/consumer storage split is now seeping into the wider market.

TrendForce's latest NAND research says AI adoption and cloud investment are driving enterprise SSD demand higher, while consumer electronics demand remains sluggish.

Its prediction for 2027 in September lays out the division even more clearly: Business SSD demand is likely to grow on AI workloads, while consumer NAND is likely to see further cost pressure and increasing Chinese competition.

This creates an appealing product combination for Sandisk.

Enterprise clients purchasing storage for AI infrastructure may support higher-value goods and longer-term contracts. PCs and cellphones are consumer products; therefore, they confront a distinct demand environment.

That's one reason Sandisk has been moving capacity into business storage.

Sandisk is spending billions to stay ahead

Sandisk is not using the present NAND scarcity as an excuse to sit back.

At its August investor day, the business shared a long-term development plan focused on its NAND technological roadmap, customer alliances, and capital allocation.

Sandisk aims to return 100% of surplus cash to shareholders after investing in the company. It has also been investing with Kioxia in innovative memory technologies.

In August, the businesses announced a high-performance 2-terabit QLC 3D flash technology for AI and data-intensive applications.

According to Sandisk tests, Sandisk's next-generation BiCS10 technology is intended to boost memory density by 60%, improve read and write bandwidth by 100%, and increase interface performance by 33% compared to BiCS8.

The company has also authorized a $14 billion share-repurchase program , taking its total remaining authorization to $15.5 billion.

That combination of capacity and technology investment with aggressive shareholder returns lies at the heart of the Sandisk story.

Sandisk's $93.9 billion of commitments creates a new challenge

Long-term contracts might have given Sandisk more insight on future income.

They also generate a delivery obligation.

In fact, NAND supply has become a key concern for the whole semiconductor industry.

Chinese memory startup CXMT is aiming to join NAND flash, possibly adding another rival to a market currently dominated by Samsung Electronics , SK Hynix , Micron Technology (MU) , and China's YMTC, Reuters reported Sept. 18.

Reuters also reported that SK Hynix's Solidigm unit is considering a U.S. NAND manufacturing facility, although no final decision has been made.

Those developments illustrate how valuable NAND capacity has become.

Sandisk is responding through its partnership with Kioxia. The two companies confirmed plans in August to invest more than $31 billion in Japan through 2032 , including a new memory-production facility at Kioxia's Kitakami plant.

Sandisk is reacting via a cooperation with Kioxia, Reuters noted. In August, the two firms said they will spend more than $31 billion in Japan until 2032, including a new memory manufacturing facility at Kioxia's Kitakami factory.

The stock has already priced in a lot of the AI boom

There's one more thing investors can't ignore: valuation.

Sandisk was split from Western Digital in February 2025 and began trading independently under the symbol SNDK.

The stock has surged in an amazing fashion. In August, Reuters reported that Sandisk shares had surged about 470% from the same time in 2026.

Historical market statistics show the stock rose to $1,791.82 on Sept. 18.

That means the question has changed.

Investors are no longer simply asking whether AI will increase demand for NAND storage.

They are asking whether Sandisk can convert that demand into durable revenue, margins, and cash flow quickly enough to justify the expectations already embedded in the stock.

Sandisk's next chapter is about execution

Sandisk has several things working for it. Fast-expanding data center revenue. Long-term customer commitments. Better enterprise SSD demand. New NAND technology. And a big approved repurchase.

But the market is changing, too.

Capacity will increase with time. Chinese competitors are becoming bigger. Other memory vendors are boosting their exposure to corporate SSDs. And Sandisk needs to keep spending while honoring the promises it has already made to its clients.

Sandisk is a vertically integrated NAND flash corporation with chip design, intellectual property, manufacturing, and systems engineering skills, according to the company's own filings.

So far, the figures tell us that AI is generating a powerful new demand driver for storage.

The difficult issue is how long the present scarcity of supply will endure and how much of that economics Sandisk can hold on to.

Sandisk has visibility to long-term deals totaling $93.9 billion. The next task is to translate that visibility into sustainable revenues while not losing its advantage as the NAND market becomes tougher.

news.Title: 友達「兩大利多」再飆漲停！11萬張搶掛還能追？分析師揭關鍵指標
news.Content:
面板大廠友達今（22）日爆量再攻第二根漲停，目前委買張數逼近12萬張，資金簇擁推升盤中成交量逼近85萬張，高居台股個股成交量之冠。市場聚焦英特爾積極布局半導體先進封裝市場，傳出有意與友達合作；此外，先前傳出有意購入友達中科5代、7.5代廠的台積電，也可能攜手友達共同推動先進封裝業務，在雙重利多題材激勵下，友達股價強勢上攻。

籌碼面同樣受到市場關注，外資昨日大買友達逾23.5萬張，自營商也買超約2.2萬張；此外，大戶持股比率也持續攀升，從8月底約41.85%，提高至9月18日的45.71%，顯示市場資金近期明顯回流面板股。

面板三虎今日延續強勁漲勢，除友達攻上漲停外，群創股價來到52元，上漲逾2%；彩晶也同步走強，股價來到15.95元，上漲逾3%。

大來投顧分析師周弘表示，從友達近期股價上漲的背景來看，市場反映的焦點未必完全來自公司實質營收及基本面表現，資產處分同樣是受到市場關注的因素之一。友達近一年積極處分廠房資產，累計交易金額達347億元，且台積電也曾購入友達位於中科的兩座廠房，市場因此持續關注公司透過資產活化所帶來的資金效益。

周弘指出，從技術面來看，帶量突破壓力區通常被視為股價轉強的重要訊號，但若成交量在短時間內急遽放大，後續仍須觀察量價結構能否延續。對於已持有友達的投資人而言，在今日成交量大幅放大的情況下，可持續觀察後續量價表現；若未來連續數個交易日仍無法延續量能並推升股價，則須留意今日大量是否反映短線獲利了結或高檔籌碼轉手，並視後續走勢重新評估操作策略。

至於尚未進場的投資人，周弘建議，考量友達今日成交量已大幅放大，可先觀察後續股價震盪及籌碼沉澱情況，不宜僅因單日爆量突破就急於追價。若後續量價表現屬於健康換手，待股價整理後，再觀察是否出現新的攻擊訊號。

news.Title: 英飛凌、德儀等國際大廠連番漲價，功率半導體進入高景氣週期
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】中國《證券時報》報導，AI數據中心帶動電源管理、高壓MOSFET及其他功率元件需求快速成長，全球功率半導體大廠今年已展開多輪調價，產業由先前去庫存階段轉向供應吃緊，景氣循環明顯升溫。海外大廠英飛凌(德股代碼IFX)、德州儀器(美股代碼TXN)、意法半導體(美股代碼STM)及安森美(美股代碼ON)均已調高部分產品價格。其中，英飛凌針對AI伺服器電源及車用功率元件的部分報價調升10%至20%，意法半導體功率元件交期一度拉長至52週，安森美則預期高價環境可延續至2027年。

財通證券指出，這一輪漲價與2021年通路商投機囤貨不同，主要增量來自海外整合元件製造商(IDM)主動提高原廠庫存，以因應實際供應缺口。瑞薩電子更把成品、裸晶圓及原材料的整體庫存目標，由120天提高至150天，顯示廠商對需求延續性及供應緊張程度的判斷已出現結構性轉變。

台灣供應鏈亦醞釀第三波調價，強茂(2481)、台半(5425)、德微(3675)及尼克森(3317)最快自10月起，針對部分非合約或現貨產品調漲10%至15%。其中，強茂產能接近滿載，部分訂單能見度延伸至2027年中；台半則持續擴充數據中心用MOSFET及高壓二極體產品線，AI機櫃功率密度提高，成為本輪功率半導體景氣上行的主要推力。

news.Title: 華邦電併NOR/F-RAM事業，補強車用/歐美客群
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-09-22 10:09:19 數位內容中心 發佈

華邦電（2344）以11.2億美元全現金收購英飛凌旗下NOR Flash與F-RAM事業100%股權，交易完成後將以Spansion品牌獨立營運，總部設於美國，並納入來自10多個國家的專業人才。這筆交易鎖定非揮發性記憶體版圖擴張，標的公司在記憶體解決方案領域已有逾30年基礎，研發據點分布歐洲、亞洲、東南亞與美國。

以產品與客戶結構來看，華邦電原有NOR Flash應用偏重PC與NB，英飛凌相關業務則握有較多歐美車用客戶，收購後可直接補強車用市場與區域客戶布局。依Omdia統計，華邦電2025年全球NOR Flash市占率23%居首，英飛凌為11%，若以現有市占率簡單加總，合計達34%。

除擴大NOR布局，華邦電也持續押注SLC NAND。現階段全球SLC NAND市占約23%，SoC NAND市占約15%，需求已從通訊、工控與消費性產品，擴至低軌衛星、機器人、無人機、穿戴裝置、AR/VR與AI手機。車用需求成為另一波拉貨來源，MCP產品整合自家SoC NAND與LPDDR4，鎖定車用Telematics、FWA與4G/5G M2M通訊模組，搭配F24製程產能擴充與高密度產品比重提升，NAND出貨與位元成長動能已看到2028年。

在供給端，華邦電今年NOR位元成長主要來自45nm產品全面放量，以及製程轉向25nm/20nm帶動單片位元出貨增加。TrendForce預估，2026年下半年NOR供需仍失衡，256Mb以上高容量產品價格仍有90%至110%上漲空間，需求主力來自AI server、車用、數位座艙與工控。AI server單台NOR需求量已是傳統server的3至5倍，也推升高容量與Octal SPI NOR拉貨。

財務面上，華邦電2026年8月合併營收273.09億元，月增2%，年增289.43%，連續9個月改寫單月新高，前8月合併營收1,521.78億元，年增177.39%。收購案預計於2027年下半年完成，完成後將開始挹注NOR Flash與F-RAM營運規模。

強茂拓印度車用工控，AI高規格產品H2驗證

研調：NOR供需H2仍失衡，高容量價格可能翻倍漲

news.Title: 「雙龍搶珠」友達亮燈創六年新高價 8萬多張排隊買不到 分析師保守點出轉折
news.Content:
友達（2409）爆出「雙龍搶珠」！轉型半導體先進封裝有成，包括英特爾、台積電（2330）都上門搶合作，連續二天漲停，盤中一度站36.65元寫下2010年2月、逾六年多來新高價，鎖漲停並高掛8萬多張買單排隊買不到，成為盤面一大亮點。同為面板雙虎之一群創（3481）今早小漲逾2%，漲勢不如友達。分析師、啟發投顧副總李永年今早接受《Yahoo股市》採訪提醒，雖技術籌碼面仍有利多方，但基本面未跟上，爆量終場若不能鎖住漲停，恐有人藉機出貨下車。

傳台積電有意取得友達中科5代、7.5代2座廠房，未來不排除攜手推動先進封裝相關業務。英特爾則是聚焦Micro LED基板先進封裝，二大半導體廠不同理由紛紛找上友達合作，讓面板廠聲勢看俏，加上股價相對便宜，股價連番急漲，今早盤中一度攻上36.65元，不僅是今年最高價，是去年底價格的將近3倍之多，亦改寫2020年2月以來的新高價。

籌碼面方面，繼昨天爆出81萬大量後，今早不到一小時就有近76萬成交，同時鎖8萬多張排隊等買。外資昨天狂買23.5萬張，高居買超第一位，亦吸引散戶跟進搶買。

基本面友達今年第2季才成功轉虧為盈，歸屬母公司淨利13.4億元，每股純益（EPS）0.18元，毛利率13%左右。友達積極布局Micro LED、矽光子、CPO與車用應用，公司日前法說會展望第3季，友達表示，消費性電子市場需求仍偏弱，不過車用業務需求維持平穩，垂直場域業務則可望延續穩健成長。

葉憶如／財經特派記者組長，主跑金管會、金控壽險、航空等

news.Title: LG攜微軟擴大AI結盟，樂金電子早盤大漲4.20%、LG控股升2.34%
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】外電報導，韓國LG集團控股公司LG Corp.(韓股代碼003550)週二宣布，與微軟(Microsoft，美股代碼MSFT)擴大戰略合作，範圍涵蓋AI數據中心基礎設施、企業AI轉型及實體AI。消息刺激LG Corp.早盤漲2.34%至11.39萬韓元，樂金電子(LG韓股代碼066570)大漲4.20%至21.1萬韓元。LG集團會長具光謨與微軟董事長兼執行長納德拉(Satya Nadella)，週一在美國華盛頓州雷德蒙德的微軟總部舉行高層會議並簽署戰略合作協議。LG電子、LG Uplus(韓股代碼032640)、LG CNS(韓股代碼064400)及LG科技園區等集團高層均出席會議。

在AI數據中心領域，雙方將結合LG電子的大型冷卻與暖通空調技術、LG新能源(韓股代碼373220)的儲能系統，以及LG CNS的數據中心設計、建造和營運能力，爭取微軟全球數據中心擴建計畫的供應商資格。短期將聚焦大容量冷卻設備，中長期則擴大至可快速建置及擴充的預製式數據中心。

雙方亦將在製造及物流現場推動實體AI，利用LG累積的工業數據及微軟Azure雲端與AI平台，建立把現場數據回饋至模型訓練的「數據飛輪」。這項合作使LG有機會由家電與電子製造商，進一步切入全球AI基礎設施供應鏈；微軟則可取得涵蓋冷卻、電力、儲能及IT建設的一站式數據中心解決方案。

news.Title: Amazon (AMZN) Bets Higher Pay Can Support its Next Phase of Growth
news.Content:
Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN ) is raising the minimum starting wage for eligible full-time U.S. core operations workers by $1 to $20 an hour, effective September 27. The company said the increase represents an investment of more than $1.5 billion, while average hourly pay for these roles will approach $24 and average total compensation, including benefits, will exceed $32 an hour.

The timing is important because Amazon's labor costs are already substantial. In the first half of 2026, fulfillment expenses increased 13% year over year to $56.9 billion, although fulfillment costs declined slightly as a percentage of sales to 14.9% from 15.6%. Amazon attributed the higher dollar expense primarily to sales growth and investments in its fulfillment network, partly offset by operational efficiencies.

Ken Wolter / Shutterstock.com

Higher Pay Could Help Amazon Reduce Turnover as Holiday Demand Approaches

The wage increase could strengthen Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN)'s ability to recruit and retain frontline workers as it enters its seasonally important fourth quarter. Amazon had about 1.58 million employees globally at the end of 2025, and its latest SEC filing notes that competition for qualified personnel remains intense across parts of the business. A more competitive wage structure could reduce turnover and hiring friction, supporting fulfillment reliability during periods of elevated order volumes.

The $1 increase also needs to be viewed against Amazon's improving operating economics. In the second quarter, North America operating income rose from $7.5 billion to $9.1 billion, while consolidated operating income increased 43% to $27.5 billion. At the same time, fulfillment expense grew 14%, meaning Amazon has continued expanding profitability despite higher fulfillment costs. The company also generated $45.4 billion in operating cash flow during the quarter, giving it substantial capacity to absorb the $1.5 billion investment.

Rising Wages Add Another Cost Challenge for Amazon's North American Operations

The immediate financial effect is still a higher structural cost base, particularly because the increase applies across eligible full-time U.S. operations workers rather than being limited to new hires. Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN)'s $1.5 billion investment comes on top of fulfillment expenses that were already rising faster than sales in the first half of 2026: fulfillment costs increased 13%, compared with 18% growth in total net sales. If future wage increases continue without corresponding productivity gains, the pressure could become more visible in North American retail margins and operating cash flow.

Story Continues

There is also a risk that the benefit to retention and productivity will take time to offset the additional payroll expense. Amazon has already been investing heavily in its fulfillment infrastructure and operational efficiency, while technology and infrastructure costs increased 25% in the first half of 2026. The wage increase therefore adds another recurring expense at a time when Amazon is simultaneously funding substantial investments across its retail and technology businesses.

Conclusion

Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN)'s $20 minimum wage is a meaningful increase in operating costs, with the company committing more than $1.5 billion to higher pay. The near-term margin effect is therefore negative, particularly for its labor-intensive North American operations. At the same time, Amazon's recent financial performance provides considerable capacity to absorb the expense: first-half operating income reached $51.3 billion, operating cash flow over the preceding 12 months was $161.4 billion, and fulfillment costs were already improving as a percentage of sales.

The key financial question is whether higher wages translate into lower turnover and better fulfillment productivity. If they do, part of the $1.5 billion investment could be recovered through efficiency and execution; if not, the increase represents a recurring cost that could weigh on retail margins.

While we acknowledge the potential of AMZN as an investment, we believe certain AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. news.Title: 不只台積電爽吃！AI狂潮燒到成熟製程 「二哥」漲價傳聞四起
news.Content:
AI熱潮持續席捲全球，市場關注焦點不再只有台積電2奈米、CoWoS與HBM，投資達人「股人阿勳」21日在 粉專 發文指出，AI產業需求可能正沿著供應鏈向外擴散，甚至開始帶動成熟製程需求升溫，晶圓代工產業供需變化浮上檯面。

股人阿勳表示，近期一項值得注意的訊號，是成熟製程晶圓代工也出現價格調整預期。他指出，聯電近期接單狀況轉強，若目前供需趨勢延續，2027年晶圓代工價格調整的幅度與全面性，可能較今年下半年更加明顯。聯電預估本季晶圓出貨量季增高個位數百分比，產能利用率已突破90%，毛利率則維持在30%中段。

另一方面，市場近期傳出力積電部分晶圓代工產品醞釀調漲，最高幅度甚至上看40%。不過，股人阿勳也特別提醒，40%目前仍屬業界傳聞，力積電並未證實具體漲幅，僅表示目前客戶需求相當強勁，因此後續仍須觀察實際報價與接單情況。

他分析，這波成熟製程需求回升，與過去手機、PC庫存回補的模式並不完全相同。隨著AI伺服器持續擴大，除了GPU、HBM及CoWoS之外，周邊還需要電源管理IC、MCU、感測器、MOSFET及其他功率元件。尤其AI伺服器功耗提高，不只是晶片數量增加，相關零組件規格也同步升級，使AI需求逐步從先進製程向成熟製程外溢。

股人阿勳認為，台積電將更多資源投入先進製程，也可能釋放部分成熟製程訂單，讓聯電、世界先進及力積電等業者有機會承接。接下來市場可觀察三項指標，包括產能利用率能否維持90%以上、平均銷售價格（ASP）是否真正上升，以及漲價能否反映在毛利率。

他指出，如果只有市場傳出漲價消息，卻沒有帶動獲利改善，可能仍屬題材；若產能利用率、ASP與毛利率同步改善，則代表成熟製程供需可能出現更實質的變化。

news.Title: Microsoft’s Higher Dividend Comes with a Modest Yield and Heavy AI Spending
news.Content:
Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ: MSFT ) has raised its quarterly dividend to $0.98 per share from $0.91, an increase of 7 cents, or about 8%. The new dividend is payable on December 10 to shareholders of record as of November 19. This marks another annual increase for Microsoft and extends its dividend-growth streak to 23 consecutive years.

At the new rate, Microsoft will pay $3.92 per share annually. Based on the stock price around the time of the announcement, that translates to a dividend yield of roughly 0.8%. That is a modest yield, so Microsoft's appeal as a dividend stock comes less from current income and more from the combination of dividend growth and the company's ability to generate substantial cash.

Pixabay/Public Domain

Microsoft's Balance Sheet Provides a Solid Cushion for Dividend Investors

The biggest positive for the dividend is Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT)'s enormous cash-generating capacity. In fiscal 2026, the company generated $182.9 billion in operating cash flow, up sharply from the prior year. It also returned more than $43 billion to shareholders through dividends and buybacks during the year.

The dividend therefore remains comfortably supported by Microsoft's underlying cash generation. Microsoft declared approximately $27 billion in dividends during fiscal 2026, compared with $182.9 billion of operating cash flow. Even after its enormous investments in infrastructure, the company has maintained enough financial flexibility to continue returning capital to shareholders.

The balance sheet also provides an additional cushion. Microsoft had $76.8 billion in cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments at the end of fiscal 2026, while management said its existing liquidity and cash flows should be sufficient to fund dividends, buybacks, debt maturities and capital expenditures for the foreseeable future.

There is also room for future dividend growth. The new $0.98 quarterly payout represents only a fraction of Microsoft's earnings and cash generation. The company generated $133.7 billion of GAAP net income in fiscal 2026, while the latest dividend increase was 8%. That gives Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) considerable flexibility to continue raising the payout without putting significant pressure on its finances.

Microsoft's AI Investment Boom Could Slow Dividend Growth

The biggest drawback is the low starting yield. At roughly 0.8%, Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT)'s dividend provides relatively little current income compared with traditional income-oriented stocks. Investors buying Microsoft primarily for dividend income would need to rely heavily on future dividend increases and potential capital appreciation rather than the current payout.

Story Continues

More importantly, Microsoft's massive AI infrastructure spending is putting increasing pressure on free cash flow. In the June quarter, Microsoft generated $55.4 billion of operating cash flow but only $19.6 billion of free cash flow, as capital expenditures reached $41 billion. Management expects fiscal 2027 capital expenditures to grow again, with first-quarter spending expected to exceed $50 billion.

That spending could limit how quickly Microsoft raises its dividend. The latest 8% increase was already below its roughly 10% average annual dividend growth over the past five years, according to Barron's. The difference matters because Microsoft's earnings and cash flows are growing rapidly, but management is simultaneously committing enormous amounts of capital to data centers, GPUs and other AI infrastructure.

The pressure is particularly visible in free cash flow. While operating cash flow increased strongly in fiscal 2026, Microsoft's additions to property and equipment jumped to $115.9 billion from $64.6 billion a year earlier. That means the company's ability to convert its growing operating cash flow into freely deployable cash is being constrained by its AI investment cycle.

Conclusion

Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT)'s latest dividend increase reinforces its strong dividend-growth profile, supported by robust cash flows and a low payout burden. However, its roughly 0.8% yield offers limited current income, while heavy AI infrastructure spending could moderate the pace of future dividend growth.

While we acknowledge the potential of MSFT as an investment, we believe certain AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. news.Title: 精材Q3營收拚高 Q4續擁動能
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-09-22 09:46:46 王怡茹 發佈

台積電(2330)轉投資封測廠精材(3374)2026年8月自結稅後淨利1.93億元、年增43%，EPS 0.71元；累計7、8月稅後淨利達3.81億元、EPS 1.4元，已逼近第二季整季的EPS 1.46元。展望後市，法人預期，公司9月營收有望維持高檔水準，帶動本季營收改寫新高，獲利則有機會拚同期高點，且在測試新產能全開下，第四季料將延續強勁成長動能。

精材因近期股價多次達公布注意交易資訊標準，故公告8月自結損益。8月營收9.09億元、年增37%，稅前淨利2.39億元、年增43%，歸屬母公司稅後淨利1.93億元、年增43%，EPS 0.71元，較去年同期0.5元成長42%。

若與2026年第二季相比，精材第二季營收21.85億元、稅前淨利4.87億元、稅後淨利3.96億元，EPS 1.46元；8月單月營收約為第二季的42%，但稅後淨利已達第二季整季近49%，顯示單月獲利表現升溫。

近年因CoWoS產能排擠效應，台積電擴大向精材釋出美系手機客戶及其他客戶測試代工訂單，公司也積極擴產支應需求。目前測試服務已成為精材主要成長引擎，第二季測試服務營收13.63億元，季增25%、年增103%，營收占比進一步拉升至62%；上半年測試服務營收則年增109%。

除了測試代工服務外，精材受惠CIS、光感測器等8吋需求好轉，以及手機用8吋光感測器新專案放量，本季即有機會達到滿載。同時，公司也布局車用、穿戴式裝置及顯示器等12吋影像感測器專案，預計2028年大規模放量。

法人認為，精材積極推動既有8吋轉向12吋的產能及製程升級，並已獲得數項新專案肯定。隨測試代工業務進入擴產收割期，後續值得關注公司能否藉由12吋製程升級，在高階3D感測元件取得更多新專案，進一步接棒成為下一波成長動能。

news.Title: 台積電訊號來了？ 魏哲家對蔡力行喊「1句話」股民嗨翻：無腦多
news.Content:
台積電董事長魏哲家近日與聯發科副董事長蔡力行一同出席「榮友會」活動時，當面表示「希望股價趕快趕上聯發科」，引發全場歡笑；相關消息曝光後，也讓股民們熱烈討論台積電與聯發科的股價差距，更有股民幽默表示「訊號來了」。

「榮友會」為台灣高含金量的聯誼組織之一，當天活動，魏哲家率台積電共同營運長秦永沛、米玉傑出席。席間，魏哲家在蔡力行面前展現老友情誼，笑談「希望股價趕快趕上聯發科」，一句話引發現場一陣笑聲。

台積電股價自6月23日創下2535元新高後，歷經7、8月的震盪，今（22）日再度站上2510元高點，而聯發科則創新高來到5480元，兩者股價仍相差2970元。

魏哲家這番話在引發股民熱議，不少網友認為是正面「訊號」，期待台積電股價有更多想像空間，「訊號出現了」、「有預告」、「無腦多」、「該創新高了」。

不過，面對近3000元的價差，也有部分網友持不同看法，股價「趕上」聯發科未必代表台積電股價上升，「聯發科跌到2400也是趕上」、「發哥腰斬也是一種方式」。

此外，也有網友指出，台積電與聯發科在股本、流通股數及市值規模皆有顯著差異，以股價比較存在一定局限，但大多數人仍對魏哲家抱有信心，紛紛留言「我信了」，對台積電未來抱持高度期待。

（封面圖／東森新聞）

news.Title: AI算力衝55 TOPS 聯發科推3奈米旗艦晶片搶攻Googlebook
news.Content:
IC設計龍頭聯發科22日宣布，推出全新Dimensity個人運算系列首款旗艦晶片Dimensity CX C10 Max，採用台積電3奈米製程操刀，正式切入Google高階超便攜筆電Googlebook市場，卡位次世代AI筆電商機。

Google甫發表全新旗艦筆電「Googlebook」，首波由宏碁、華碩等品牌操刀的機種已於9月21日啟動預購，預計10月4日陸續出貨，初期以英特爾與高通處理器為主。聯發科則端出旗艦晶片，預告搭載聯發科平台的新機種即將問世，宣告台廠晶片正式打入Google新PC生態圈核心。

Dimensity CX C10 Max採用台積電3奈米製程，配置全大核8核心CPU與11核心GPU，鎖定無風扇、全天候長續航設計。其第8代NPU 890算力高達55 TOPS，超越市場現有同級競品，專為Google終端AI助理Gemini深度優化，可大幅加速運算反應並強化隱私保護，並支援3200萬畫素相機、Wi-Fi 7與藍牙6.0規格。

聯發科資深副總經理暨數據中心與運算事業群總經理Vince Hu指出，該晶片結合旗艦效能與高能效架構，能在帶來絕佳體驗的同時兼顧電池續航力，也深化與Google在個人運算領域的長期合作。

面對英特爾與高通在AI PC領域正面交鋒，聯發科攜手台積電先進製程強勢插旗Googlebook高階生態系，除了開闢智慧型手機以外的營收新動能，也讓台系供應鏈在次世代AI終端洗牌戰中搶占制高點。

news.Title: Why Intel, Arm, and Other AI Chip Stocks Soared Today
news.Content:
Meta Platform 's (NASDAQ: META) new Muse personal artificial intelligence (AI) agent is off to a fast start.

After being the most downloaded free iPhone app in the U.S. for the past three days, according to Sensor Tower, Muse has investors excited about a potential boom in AI agent-fueled sales of central processing units (CPUs).

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

That, in turn, is driving up the stock prices of the leading CPU makers. Here's how some of the top AI chip stocks performed on Monday:

Arm Holdings (NASDAQ: ARM), up 17%

Intel (NASDAQ: INTC), up 12%

Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ: AMD), up 10%

Meta's Muse is grabbing investors' attention

Meta's new AI agent promises to quickly, easily, and securely perform multiple tasks for users, such as sorting email, booking reservations, and managing calendars.

Muse is more accessible than other popular agentic AI projects, such as OpenClaw. It's also backed by Meta's tremendous data collection and distribution capabilities, thanks to the social media giant's staggering 3.6 billion daily active users.

In turn, analysts believe Muse has the potential to attract hundreds of millions of users in the coming months. That would likely make it the most popular AI agent on the market.

AI agents are set to boost demand for CPU makers

While AI model training requires mostly GPU-based compute, agentic AI is powered more by inference, which requires a greater proportion of CPUs to handle tasks like planning and orchestration.

A forthcoming wave of agentic AI-powered applications is thus expected to drive demand for CPUs sharply higher in the coming years. ARM sees the server CPU market surging by 35% annually to $120 billion by 2030, while AMD predicts 50% annual growth to $220 billion by the end of the decade.

As the leading designers of CPUs and related infrastructure, Intel, AMD, and Arm stand to profit handsomely from these trends.

news.Title: 1分鐘讀財經》董座喊「DRAM不缺」！外資逆勢挺南亞科 「8字頭」目標價全解密
news.Content:
小編今天（22）日精選5件國內外重要財經大事。宏碁董事長陳俊聖日前拋出「記憶體已不缺」震撼彈，儘管外界各自解讀，21日仍壓抑記憶體族群走勢。瑞銀證券、中信投顧此時攜手挺身看好指標股南亞科，樂觀派內外資股價預期共識升至6字頭以上，樂觀情境甚至有800元潛力。

【1】內外資力挺 南亞科目標價喊升

瑞銀目前預估，南亞科第三季DRAM位元出貨量將季增5％，優於先前預估的季減8％；更值得注意的是，DRAM單位售價預估將季增50％，也明顯高於先前預估的季增32％。瑞銀認為，主要受惠為期6～12個月的合約於7月重新議價，使第三季價格季增幅度高於一般水準。

【2】漲價潮擴散 功率元件三強有戲

全球功率半導體漲價潮持續擴散，繼德州儀器、瑞薩陸續傳出調價後，安森美也傳出通知客戶將自10月10日起調整部分產品價格。國際大廠接連出手，有助降低台廠與客戶協商漲價阻力，強茂、台半、德微等功率元件廠第四季至2027年營運，除受惠AI拉貨，亦有望迎來產品組合及價格同步改善。

【3】CCL掀全球擴產競賽 三雄也跟上

AI伺服器、高速交換器需求強勁，全球高階銅箔基板（CCL）掀起擴產競賽。韓國斗山（Doosan）宣布斥資9,700億韓元，在韓國及中國大陸同步擴充高階CCL產能；台灣CCL三雄台光電、台燿、聯茂今年也全面加碼資本支出，提前卡位AI帶動的高速材料商機。

【4】超進度 台積A14明年Q1試產

AI算力競賽推動先進製程由「奈米」加速跨入「埃」世代。IC設計業者透露，台積電 A14（1.4奈米）進度持續超前，今年第二季已啟動CyberShuttle（晶圓共乘）服務，預計2027年首季於新竹寶山Fab20廠進入試產；主力量產廠區台中Fab25則規劃明年第二季前完工、最快第三季初投入試產。與台積電官方時程2027年風險試產、2028年量產進度相符。

【5】美伊本周談判？ 油價下挫

美伊外交談判前景好轉，加上摩根大通稱中東石油輸出狀況比預期更穩健，受此影響，國際油價連續四個交易日下跌。布蘭特期油與美國西德州期油21日盤中均大跌逾3％，前者多在每桶100美元附近盤旋、後者則來到97美元價位附近，皆創下9月9日以來新低水準。
